original: anyatra lakṣmyāḥ lakṣmīśabdasya | arthagatasya strītvasya śabde āropaḥ | sakhyuḥ sakhiśabdasya patyuḥ patiśabdasya ca | ghitāguṇābhāvaḥ ghitā ghisaṃjñakatvam | tena yo guṇaḥ ‘gherṅiti' iti vihito guṇaḥ tasya abhāvaḥ prathata iti yuktam |
analyzed: anyatra lakṣmyāḥ lakṣmī śabdasya artha gatasya strī tvasya śabde āropaḥ sakhyuḥ sakhi śabdasya patyuḥ pati śabdasya ca tena yaḥ guṇaḥ iti vihitaḥ guṇaḥ tasya abhāvaḥ prathate iti yuktam

analyzed: lakṣmī śabdasya nadī saṃjñaka dīrghe varṇa anta tvena śeṣaḥ ghi a sakhi iti a nadī saṃjñaka hrasve varṇaḥ varṇa anta tva nibandhana ghi saṃjñāyāḥ tatra apravṛtteḥ tatra eva ghi saṃjñā vidhāyake sūtre a sakhi iti sakhi śabdasya paryudasta tvāt

original: sakhiśabdasya ‘patissamāsa eva' iti samāsa eva patiśabdasya ghisaṃjñāyā niyamitatvenāsamastapatiśabdasya ca tadabhāvāt ghisaṃjñāprayuktaguṇābhāvaḥ prasiddha iti yuktam | bhavitāpratyayasyetyatra bhavitā āpratyayasyeti chedaḥ |

original: āpratyayasya āṅsaṃjñasya ṭāpratyayasya nābhāvaḥ 'āṅo nāstriyām' iti vihitasya nādeśasyābhāvaḥ bhaviteti yat idamapi yuktaṃ vidmaḥ| lakṣmīsakhi patiśabdānāmuktarītyā ghisaṃjñāyā evābhāvānna tatkāryanābhāva iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā apiśabdo garhāyāṃ, apīdaṃ yuktaṃ vidma iti yojanā |
analyzed: ā pratyayasya āṅ saṃjñasya ṭā pratyayasya na abhāvaḥ āṅaḥ na a striyām iti vihitasya na ādeśasya abhāvaḥ bhavitā iti yat idam api yuktam vidmaḥ lakṣmī sakhi pati śabdānām ukta rītyā ghi saṃjñāyāḥ eva abhāvāt na tad kārya nābhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yat vā api śabdaḥ garhāyām api idam yuktam vidmaḥ iti yojanā

original: asmin pakṣe āpratyayasya āṅaḥ nābhāvaḥ nātvaṃ bhaviteti yat tat yuktaṃ vidmaḥ kiṃ ? teṣāṃ śabdānāṃ ghisaṃjñāyā evābhāvena āṅo nādeśo bhaviteti na yuktaṃ vidma ityarthaḥ || yathāvā

original: atra bhagavadupāsakasya prakṛtasya tvadbhogīnādiśabdasyāprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi he svāmin ! tvadbhogīnaḥ tavaiva bhogāya hitaḥ na tu svasya, tvadbhogasaṃpādanaikatānaḥ tvaccheṣataikarasa iti yāvat | ‘paragatātiśayādhānecchayā upādeyatvameva yasya svarūpaṃ sa śeṣaḥ' iti hi śeṣalakṣaṇam |
analyzed: atra bhagavat upāsakasya prakṛtasya tvad bhogīna ādi śabdasya aprakṛtasya ca śleṣaḥ tathā hi he svāmin tvad bhogīnaḥ tava eva bhogāya hitaḥ na tu svasya tvad bhoga saṃpādana ekatānaḥ tvad śeṣa tā ekarasaḥ iti yāvat para gata atiśaya ādhāna icchayā upādeya tvam eva yasya svarūpam sa śeṣaḥ iti hi śeṣa lakṣaṇam

original: ata eva viśvajanīnaḥ sarvajanāya hitaḥ ātmanīnaḥ ātmane hitaśca svaparahitācaraṇaikavṛttirityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca 'svaparahitaparaṃ deśikam' iti | īdṛśaḥ ātmā cetanaḥ hitārthasukhena hitaṃ bhagavatprāptyupāyaḥ arthaḥ paramapuruṣārthaḥ hitārthaśabdau tadjñānaparau | idaṃ tattvajñānasyāpyupalakṣakam | tābhyāṃ yatsukhaṃ ānandaḥ tena prathitassan bhāti |
analyzed: atas eva viśvajanīnaḥ sarva janāya hitaḥ ātmanīnaḥ ātmane hitaḥ ca sva para hita ācaraṇa eka vṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ uktam ca sva para hita param deśikam iti īdṛśaḥ ātmā cetanaḥ hita artha sukhena hitam bhagavat prāpti upāyaḥ arthaḥ parama puruṣa arthaḥ hita artha śabdau tad jñāna parau idam tattva jñānasya api upalakṣakam tābhyām yat sukham ānandaḥ tena prathitaḥ san bhāti

original: atha śarīrāvasāne prakṛtyā ca āvirbhūtaguṇāṣṭakādiviśiṣṭatvarūpeṇa svasvabhāvena ca bhātītyanuṣajyate dīpyate | tvaccheṣataikaraso viśvajanāya svacchātrabhūtāyātmane ca hitakṛccetanastattvahitapuruṣārthajñānaprayuktānandavattayeha pratītaśśarīrāvasāne cāvirbhūtasvābhāvikāpahatapāpmatvādibrāhmaguṇo nityāsaṃkucitajñānatayā prakāśate mukto bhavatīti
analyzed: atha śarīra avasāne prakṛtyā ca āvirbhūta guṇa aṣṭaka ādi viśiṣṭa tva rūpeṇa sva svabhāvena ca bhāti iti anuṣajyate dīpyate tvad śeṣa tā eka rasaḥ viśva janāya sva chātra bhūtāya ātmane ca hita kṛt cetanaḥ tattva hita puruṣa artha jñāna prayukta ānandavat tayā iha pratītaḥ śarīra avasāne ca āvirbhūta svābhāvika apahata pāpma tva ādi brāhma guṇaḥ nitya asaṃkucita jñānatayā prakāśate muktaḥ bhavati iti

original: hitārthe hitarūpe'rthe ‘tasmai hitam' iti sūtreṇa vihite śobhanaścāsau khaśva sukhaḥ ‘ātmanviśvajanabhogottarapadātkhaḥ' iti vihito yaḥ khapratyayaḥ tasya yaḥ īnaḥ 'āyaneyīnīyiyaḥ' ityādinā vihita īnādeśaḥ tena prathitassan bhātīti pratyekaṃ tvadbhogīna ityādibhissaṃbadhyate | tvadbhogīnādiśabdatrayasyoktaprakriyāniṣpannatvāttathoktiḥ |
analyzed: hita arthe hita rūpa īrthe tasmai hitam iti sūtreṇa vihite śobhanaḥ ca asau sukhaḥ ātman viśva jana bhoga uttara padāt khaḥ iti vihitaḥ yaḥ kha pratyayaḥ tasya yaḥ īnaḥ ityādinā vihitaḥ īna ādeśaḥ tena prathitaḥ san bhāti iti pratyekam tvad bhogīnaḥ ityādibhiḥ saṃbadhyate tvad bhogīna ādi śabda trayasya ukta prakriyā niṣpanna tvāt tathā uktiḥ

original: athātmanīnaśabde viśeṣaṃ ca darśayaty athetyādinā | atheti viśeṣadyotakam | ātmā ātmaśabdaḥ prakṛtyā ca bhāti ‘ātmādhvānau khe' iti sūtravihitaṃ prakṛtibhāvamāpannaḥ prakāśate | yathāvasthitasvarūpa eva bhavati, na tu ‘nastaddhite' iti ṭilopaṃ prāpnoti | khapratyayaśśabdatraye'pyaviśiṣṭa eva, ātmaśabde tu prakṛtibhāvo viśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: atha ātmanīna śabde viśeṣam ca darśayati atha ityādinā atha iti viśeṣa dyotakam ātmā ātma śabdaḥ prakṛtyā ca bhāti ātma adhvānau khe iti sūtra vihitam prakṛti bhāvam āpannaḥ prakāśate yathā avasthita svarūpaḥ eva bhavati na tu naḥ taddhite iti ṭi lopam prāpnoti kha pratyayaḥ śabda traye pi aviśiṣṭaḥ eva ātma śabde tu prakṛti bhāvaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: sakto bhajati dadhāti spaṣṭaṃ hitatāṃ phaṇīśagiribhavanaḥ | svaujasi pareśatā'sminnanumāgamatoviśeṣabhāgbhavati || 841 ||
analyzed: saktaḥ bhajati dadhāti spaṣṭam hita tām phaṇīśa giri bhavanaḥ sva ojasi pareśa tā asmin anu māgamataḥ viśeṣa bhāj bhavati

original: atra prastutasya bhagavataḥ aprastutasya dhāñdhātoḥ bhajadhātośca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi phaṇīśagiriḥ bhavanaṃ yasya saḥ śrīnivāsaḥ bhajati bhakte jane saktaḥ prītimān ‘priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ' iti gānāt | ata eva hitatāṃ tasmai bhaktimate upāyopeyabhāvena hitakāritāṃ dadhāti bibharti spaṣṭaṃ nātra viśayaleśo'pīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atra prastutasya bhagavataḥ aprastutasya śleṣaḥ tathā hi phaṇīśa giriḥ bhavanam yasya saḥ śrīnivāsaḥ bhajati bhakte jane saktaḥ prītimān priyaḥ hi jñāninā utyartham aham sa ca mama priyaḥ iti gānāt atas eva hita tām tasmai bhaktimate upāya upeya bhāvena hita kāri tām dadhāti bibharti spaṣṭam na atra viśaya leśaḥ upi iti bhāvaḥ

original: svaujasi svā ojasīticchedaḥ ojasi ‘paraṃ jyotirupasaṃpadya' iti śrute divyatejorūpe | yadvā svā aujasīticchedaḥ | ā samantāt ojaḥ prakāśo yasya tasmin sarvavyāpiniratiśayatejasi asmin parabrahmāṇi śrīnivāse vidyamānā |
analyzed: sva ojasi svāḥ ojasi iti chedaḥ ojasi param jyotiḥ upasaṃpadye iti śrute divya tejaḥ rūpe yat vā svāḥ aujasi iti chedaḥ ā samantāt ojaḥ prakāśaḥ yasya tasmin sarva vyāpi niratiśaya tejasi asmin para brahmāṇi śrīnivāse vidyamānā

original: svā svatassiddhā paraścāsāvīśaśca pareśaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ pareśatā pāramaiśvaryaṃ 'īśassarvasya jagataḥ, eṣa sarveśvaraḥ' ityādiśruteḥ | nanu māgamata iticchedaḥ | māyāḥ śriyaḥ āgamataḥ saṃbandhāt viśeṣabhāgbhavati nanu | bhagavataśśrīnivāsasya svābhāvikamaiśvaryaṃ parimalādiva hemāravindaṃ śrīsaṃbandhādāmreḍitavaibhavaṃ bhavatyevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: svā svatas siddhā paraḥ ca asau īśaḥ ca pareśaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ pareśatā pāramaiśvaryam īśaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ eṣa sarva īśvaraḥ ityādi śruteḥ nanu mā āgamataḥ iti chedaḥ māyāḥ śriyaḥ āgamataḥ saṃbandhāt viśeṣa bhāj bhavati nanu bhagavataḥ śrīnivāsasya svābhāvikam aiśvaryam parimalāt iva hema aravindam śrī saṃbandhāt āmreḍita vaibhavam bhavati eva iti arthaḥ

original: nanuravadhāraṇe | uttarārdhena paratvaṃ pūrvārdhena saulabhyaṃ ca darśitam | yadvā uttarārdhasyaivamarthaḥ svaṃ ojaḥ yasya tasmin svaujasi svaprakāśasvarūpe asmin śrīnivāse vidyamānā īśatā aiśvaryam | anumāgamata iti samastaṃ padam | anumā anumānaṃ smṛtiḥ āgamaḥ śrutiḥ tayoḥ anumāgamataḥ 'ādyādibhyaḥ' iti sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ |
analyzed: uttara ardhena paratvam pūrva ardhena saulabhyam ca darśitam yat vā uttara ardhasya evam arthaḥ svam ojaḥ yasya tasmin sva ojasi sva prakāśa svarūpe asmin śrīnivāse vidyamānā īśatā aiśvaryam anumā āgamataḥ iti samastam padam anumā anumānam smṛtiḥ āgamaḥ śrutiḥ tayoḥ ādi ādibhyaḥ iti sārvavibhaktikaḥ tasiḥ

original: parā dūrā ‘yato vāco nivartante' ityādiśruteḥ tadaviṣaya ityarthaḥ | ‘paraṃ dūrānyamukhyeṣu paro'riparamātmanoḥ' iti vaijayantī | yadvā anumāgamataḥ śrutismṛtibhyāṃ uktetyadhyāhāraḥ pareśatā pāramaiśvaryaṃ aviśeṣabhāgiticchedaḥ | aviḥ śailaḥ ‘avayaśśailameṣārkāḥ' ityamaraḥ | sa cāsau śeṣaśca aviśeṣaḥ śailākārabhāk śeṣaḥ śeṣādrirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: parāḥ dūrāḥ yatas vācaḥ nivartante ityādi śruteḥ tad aviṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ param dūra anya mukhyeṣu iti vaijayantī yat vā śruti smṛtibhyām uktā iti adhyāhāraḥ pareśa tā pāramaiśvaryam aviśeṣa bhāj iti chedaḥ aviḥ śailaḥ avayaḥ śaila meṣa arkāḥ iti amaraḥ sa ca asau śeṣaḥ ca aviśeṣaḥ śaila ākāra bhāj śeṣaḥ śeṣa adriḥ iti arthaḥ

original: taṃ bhajatīti tathoktā bhavati | parasmin brahmaṇi vidyamānaṃ pāramaiśvaryaṃ sarvamapi śeṣādrāveva cakāsti tasyātrāvirbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | asmin pakṣe uttarārdhenaiva krameṇa paratvasaulabhyoktiḥ | yadvā svaujasi svamahimapratiṣṭhite ‘ojo bale prabhāve ca' ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: tam bhajati iti tathā uktā bhavati parasmin brahmaṇi vidyamānam pāramaiśvaryam sarvam api śeṣa adrau eva cakāsti tasya atra āvirbhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ asmin pakṣe uttara ardhena eva krameṇa paratva saulabhya uktiḥ yat vā sva ojasi sva mahima pratiṣṭhite ojaḥ bale prabhāve ca iti amaraḥ

original: atra prakṛtasya brahmavidaḥ aprakṛtasya brahmaśabdasya ca śleṣaḥ | tathāhi iha bṛṃhati parabhūmani na udbhavati prakṛtisaṃgataḥ nu mataḥ brahmaṇi naraḥ tathātve no syāt na api atra vaśīkṛtīḍitatā iti padacchedaḥ |

original: naraḥ cetanaḥ parabhūmani niratiśayamahimani ‘yatra nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti sa bhūmā' ityuktarītyā niratiśayavaipulyaviśiṣṭe ityarthaḥ | ata eva bṛṃhati vardhamāne 'nainamūrthvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye parijagrabhat' ityādyuktarītyā sarvavyāpinītyarthaḥ | brahmaṇi viṣaye mataḥ mantā 'matibuddhi' ityādinā kartari ktaḥ |
analyzed: naraḥ cetanaḥ para bhūmani niratiśaya mahimani yatra na anyat paśyati na anyat śṛṇoti na anyat vijānāti sa bhūmā iti ukta rītyā niratiśaya vaipulya viśiṣṭe iti arthaḥ atas eva bṛṃhati vardhamāne na enam ūrthvam na tiryañcam na madhye parijagrabhat ityādi ukta rītyā sarvavyāpinī iti arthaḥ brahmaṇi viṣaye mataḥ mantā mati buddhi ityādinā kartari ktaḥ

original: pakṣe yaḥ ‘viśa praveśane' iti paṭhito dhātuḥ parasmaipadāya ‘laḥ parasmaipadam' iti vihitāya parasmaipadasaṃjñakāya lādeśāya abhyarhet yogyassyāt viśadhātoḥ parasmaipadiṣu paṭhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: pakṣe yaḥ viśa praveśane iti paṭhitaḥ dhātuḥ parasmaipadāya laḥ parasmaipadam iti vihitāya parasmaipada saṃjñakāya la ādeśāya abhyarhet yogyaḥ syāt viśa dhātoḥ parasmaipadiṣu paṭhita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasmai svajuṣe svasamabhivyāhārabhāje viśe viśadhātave devaḥ devayati dhātvarthaṃ dyotayatīti devaḥ dīvyaterṇijantātpacādyac upasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvāddeva ityuktiḥ | niḥ nītyākārakaḥ upasargaḥ ‘upasargāḥ kriyāyoge' ityanuśiṣṭo nipātaviśeṣaḥ |

original: ātmanepadaṃ ‘taṅānāvātmanepadam' iti vihitaṃ śānajākhyamātmanepadasaṃjñakaṃ pratyayaṃ pradadāti ‘nerviśaḥ' ityanena nītyupasargātparībhūtasya viśaterātmanepadānuśāsanāttasya taddattatvopacāraḥ | sa ca nītyupasargaviśiṣṭo viśadhāturapi | tatra tasminnātmanepade pare satīti śeṣaḥ | niviśamāno bhavati tathā niṣpadyate |

original: ‘etasya vā akṣarasya praśāsane gārgi sūryācandramasau vidhṛtau tiṣṭhataḥ | antaḥ praviṣṭaśśāstā janānā m̐ sarvātmā | ekaśśāstā na dvitīyo'sti śāstā | śāstā viṣṇuraśeṣasya | praśāsitāraṃ sarveṣām' ityādipramāṇāt | āṅpūrvakāddiśeḥ karaṇe ghañ, 'akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām' ityanuśāsanāt |

original: na ca vivakṣitādeśakartṛtvarūpārthavirodhaśśaṅkyaḥ ‘vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ' itiśābdikoktanayātkartaryeva karaṇāntaranairapekṣyeṇa sādhakatamatvavivakṣayā tathā prayogopapatteḥ | ādeśameva viśinaṣṭi yeneti | yena śruteneti yāvat | aśrutamapi sarvaṃ spaṣṭaṃ yathā syāttathā śrutaṃ bhavati |

original: idamupalakṣaṇaṃ śrutena matena vijñātena aśrutamamatamavijñātaṃ śrutaṃ mataṃ vijñātaṃ bhavatītyasya | atra ‘uta tamādeśamaprākṣyo yenāśrutaṃ śrutam' iti sadvidyāvākyārthassarvo'pi pratyabhijñāpitaḥ |

original: atra ‘yenāśrutaṃ śrutaṃ bhavati' ityatra ‘kasminnu bhagavo vijñāte sarvamidaṃ vijñātaṃ bhavati, ātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāte idaṃ sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhavati' iti muṇḍakabṛhadāraṇyakavākyānurodhena yena śrutenetyādyartho varṇitaḥ | yenāśrutaṃ śrutamityanena upādānatvaṃ praśāsitṛtvārthakādeśaśabdena cātmasvarūpamuktam |

original: muktāvalīpakṣe tu śrīramyā sā ekāvalyabhikhyayā bhāti alaṃkṛtiḥ ślāghyā sādhu kṛtā arthaśreṇīgṛhītamuktā ākṛtiḥ yasyāḥ itichedaḥ | śriyā lāvaṇyalakṣmyā ramyā ramaṇīyā ślāghyā sā alaṃkṛtiḥ ābharaṇaṃ ekāvalyabhikhyayā ekāvalīnāmnā ‘ekāvalyekayaṣṭikā' ityamaraḥ |

original: ekāvalyalaṃkārapakṣe tu pūrvārdhe pūrvavadeva chedaḥ | uttarārdhe tu sādhu kṛtā arthaśreṇī gṛhītamuktākṛtiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ | śriyā kāvyalakṣmyā ramyā sā alaṃkṛtiḥ alaṃkāraḥ ekāvalyabhikhyayā tannāmnā ślāghyā satī bhāti | yasyāḥ alaṃkṛteḥ arthānāṃ abhidheyānāṃ śreṇī paṅktiḥ gṛhītamuktā ākṛtiḥ yasyāssā tathoktā |

analyzed: śūreṣu yadu viśeṣeṣu vikhyātaḥ yena sa śauriḥ iti abhidhīyate dyumaṇi śabdena paratvam śūra vikhyāta śabdena saulabhyam ca darśitam deva uttamaḥ caturmukha ādīnām api uttamaḥ yatra devānām adhidevaḥ āste ityādi śruteḥ nalina dala īkṣaṇaḥ puṇḍarīka palāśa locanaḥ bhagavān iha asmin loke sutarām bhāyāt

original: indrapakṣe svarūpāsitabhāḥ svaruṇā vajreṇa ‘śatakoṭissvaruḥ' ityamaraḥ | upāsitā svasminnupaveśitā tena sevitā vā ‘āsa upaveśane' asmāṇṇijantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | bhāḥ prabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ vajrāyudhonmiṣitaprabhāva ityarthaḥ | ‘bhāḥ prabhāve mayūkhe'strī' iti medinī | dyumaṇiḥ svarlokābharaṇabhūtaḥ 'dyauḥ strī svarge ca gagane' iti medinī |

original: ādityapakṣe tu svarūpe svākāre āsitā upaveśitā | yadvā svarūpeṇa svabhāvenaiva ā samantāt sitā baddhā bhāḥ dīptiḥ yasmin sa tathoktaḥ | ‘ṣiñ bandhane' karmaṇi ktaḥ| 'mudditaṃ saṃditaṃ sitam' ityamaraḥ | svabhāvato niścaladīptirityarthaḥ |

original: athavā āsitaṃ sthitiḥ āserbhāve ktaḥ svarūpasyāsitaṃ tena bhāsata iti svarūpāsitabhāḥ, bhāsateḥ kvip, svarūpasthityaiva bhāsamāna ityarthaḥ | sadātmanibiḍaujāḥ san svasminvidyamānaḥ ‘satye sādhau vidyamāne praśaste'bhyarhite ca sat' ityamaraḥ | yaḥ ātmā paramapuruṣaḥ 'ya eṣontarāditye hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti śruteḥ |

original: tena nibiḍaujāḥ ‘na tatra sūryo bhati' ityārabhya ‘tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti' ityādityāditejasāṃ tadupajīvyatvaśravaṇāt | nalinadalekṣaṇaḥ dalayatīti dalaṃ 'dala viśaraṇe' asmāddhātorṇijantātpacādyac | ‘ṇeraniṭi' iti ṇilopaḥ |

original: tena ca tatprārthanākaraṇe mlāniśaṅkayā'vaśyopādeyatvaṃ tadvacaso dhvanyate | vāṇyāḥ ‘kimevaṃ nirdoṣaḥ ka iha jagati' ityādyuktaprakārāyāḥ vācaḥ vaśagaḥ vaśyaḥ | ata eva sumanasāṃ viduṣāṃ bhavaṃ saṃsāraṃ haratīti sumanobhavahārī san nije svakīye pade caraṇe sthāne vā lagnān tāneva sumanasa iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tena ca tad prārthanā karaṇe mlāni śaṅkayā avaśya upādeya tvam tad vacasaḥ dhvanyate vāṇyāḥ kim evam nirdoṣaḥ kaḥ iha jagati ityādi ukta prakārāyāḥ vācaḥ vaśagaḥ vaśyaḥ atas eva sumanasām viduṣām bhavam saṃsāram harati iti sumanaḥ bhava hārī san nije svakīye pade caraṇe sthāne vā lagnān tān eva sumanasaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: satkāmān satyakāmān āvirbhūtakalyāṇaguṇānityarthaḥ | tanoti | anatikramaṇīyaśrīvacanavibhavavivaśo bhagavānniśśeṣāvidyānivartanapūrvakaṃ svāśritānāvirbhūtaguṇāṣṭakānvidadhātīti nirgalito'rthaḥ ||
analyzed: satkāmān satya kāmān āvirbhūta kalyāṇa guṇān iti arthaḥ tanoti an atikramaṇīya śrīvacana vibhava vivaśaḥ bhagavān niśśeṣa avidyā nivartana pūrvakam sva āśritān āvirbhūta guṇa aṣṭakān vidadhāti iti nirgalita ūrthaḥ

original: caturmukhapakṣe kamalapadāyāḥ nalinamṛdulacaraṇāyāḥ gauryāḥ 'yā kundendutuṣārahāradhavalā' ityuktarītyā viśadavarṇāyāḥ sadā'pi sādhurateḥ sādhuṣu sabhyeṣu vidvatsu ratiḥ prītiḥ yasyāḥ tathoktāyāḥ vāgdevatātvāditi bhāvaḥ | ‘sādhustriṣūcite cārau sabhye vārdhuṣike tu nā' iti ratnamālā | vāṇyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ vaśagaḥ |
analyzed: caturmukha pakṣe kamala padāyāḥ nalina mṛdula caraṇāyāḥ gauryāḥ yā kunda indu tuṣāra hāra dhavalā iti ukta rītyā viśada varṇāyāḥ sadā api sādhu rateḥ sādhuṣu sabhyeṣu vidvatsu ratiḥ prītiḥ yasyāḥ tathā uktāyāḥ vāgdevatā tvāt iti bhāvaḥ sādhuḥ triṣu ucite cārau sabhye vārdhuṣike tu nā iti ratnamālā vāṇyāḥ sarasvatyāḥ vaśagaḥ

original: sumanasi bisaprasūne padme bhavena janmanā 'janmaharau bhavau' ityamaraḥ | hārī manoharaḥ bhagavannābhinalinajanmetyarthaḥ | ajaḥ caturmukhaḥ | nijapadalagnān satyalokagatān satkāmān ramaṇīyabhogyavastuśālinaḥ tanotīti ||
analyzed: sumanasi bisaprasūne padme bhavena janmanā janma harau bhavau iti amaraḥ hārī manoharaḥ bhagavat nābhi nalina janma iti arthaḥ ajaḥ caturmukhaḥ nija pada lagnān satya loka gatān sat kāmān ramaṇīya bhogya vastu śālinaḥ tanoti iti

original: īśānapakṣe kamalapadāyāḥ padyata iti padā padyateḥ pacādyac | kamalasya kuraṅgasya padā, kamalaḥ kuraṅgaḥ padaṃ cihnaṃ yasyāsseti vā tasyāḥ ubhayathā'pi kuraṅgapāṇerityarthaḥ | ‘syātkuraṅge'pi kamalaḥ, padaṃ vyavasitatrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu' iti cāmaraḥ | yadyapi kuraṅgapāṇitvamīśānasyaiva prasiddhyati |
analyzed: īśāna pakṣe kamala padāyāḥ padyate iti padā padyateḥ kamalasya kuraṅgasya padā kamalaḥ kuraṅgaḥ padam cihnam vā tasyāḥ ubhayathā api kuraṅga pāṇeḥ iti arthaḥ syāt kuraṅge api kamalaḥ padam vyavasita trāṇa sthāna lakṣma aṅghri vastuṣu iti ca amaraḥ yadi api kuraṅga pāṇi tvam īśānasya eva prasiddhi ati

original: tathā'pyumāyāstadardhāṅgatayā taduktiriti dhyeyam | ata eva ‘dīpakamṛgāyamāṇanijahariṇaśāvakānudhāvyamānapārṣṇibhāgau' iti hariṇasyobhayasādhāraṇyoktissaṃgacchate | yadvā kamalāni uttamamahilātvasūcakarekhākārapadmāni pade yasyāsseti | sādhurateḥ ramaṇiyavallabhaprīteḥ | gauryāḥ pārvatyāḥ vāṇyāḥ vācaḥ vaśagaḥ |
analyzed: tathā api umāyāḥ tad ardha aṅgatayā tad uktiḥ iti dhyeyam atas eva dīpaka mṛgāyamāṇa nija hariṇa śāvaka anudhāvyamāna pārṣṇi bhāgau iti hariṇasya ubhaya sādhāraṇya uktiḥ saṃgacchate yat vā kamalāni uttama mahilā tva sūcaka rekhā ākāra padmāni pade yasyāḥ sā iti sādhu rateḥ gauryāḥ pārvatyāḥ vāṇyāḥ vācaḥ vaśagaḥ

original: manobhavaṃ manmathaṃ haratīti manobhavahārī | suṣṭhu manobhavahārī sumanobhavahārī kandarpavairītyarthaḥ | ajaḥ īśānaḥ nijapadalagnān svacaraṇasaktān satkāmān vidyamānamadanān tanotīti virodhaḥ, phalitamanorathāṃstanotīti parihāraḥ ||
analyzed: manobhavam manmatham harati iti manobhava hārī suṣṭhu manobhava hārī su manobhava hārī kandarpa vairī iti arthaḥ ajaḥ īśānaḥ nija pada lagnān sva caraṇa saktān sat kāmān vidyamāna madanān tanoti iti virodhaḥ phalita manorathān tanoti iti parihāraḥ

original: smarapakṣe tu kamalapadāyāḥ aruṇāmbujacaraṇāyā gauryāḥ aruṇavarṇāyāḥ pātivratyena viśuddhāyā vā | ‘gauraḥ pīte'ruṇe śvete viśuddhe cābhidheyavat' iti medinī | rateḥ ratidevyāḥ vāṇyāḥ vācaḥ sādhu yathā syāttathā vaśagaḥ | tadājñāvaśaṃvada ityarthaḥ | suṣṭha manasi citte bhavena janmanā hārī ramyaḥ manasija ityarthaḥ | ajaḥ smaraḥ |
analyzed: smara pakṣe tu kamala padāyāḥ aruṇa ambuja caraṇāyāḥ gauryāḥ aruṇa varṇāyāḥ pātivratyena viśuddhāyāḥ vā gauraḥ pīta iruṇe śvete viśuddhe ca abhidheya vat iti medinī rateḥ ratidevyāḥ vāṇyāḥ vācaḥ sādhu yathā syāt tathā vaśagaḥ tad ājñā vaśaṃvadaḥ iti arthaḥ suṣṭha manasi citte bhavena janmanā hārī ramyaḥ manasijaḥ iti arthaḥ ajaḥ smaraḥ

original: kośastūdāhṛta eva | nijapadeṣu svakīyavastuṣu ālambanaguṇādyuddīpanavibhāveṣvityarthaḥ | lagnān abhiṣaktān janān satkāmān ūrjitapreyasīsaṃbhogābhilāṣān tanotīti ||
analyzed: kośaḥ tu udāhṛtaḥ eva nija padeṣu svakīya vastuṣu ālambana guṇa ādi uddīpana vibhāveṣu iti arthaḥ lagnān abhiṣaktān janān sat kāmān ūrjita preyasī saṃbhoga abhilāṣān tanoti iti

original: yathāvā
analyzed: yathā vā

original: puṣkalasacchrīlakṣaṇahṛdyo yo bahuvirocanābhikhyaḥ | vidyudbhājayatu harissa vṛtrasaṃhananabhiduravarahetiḥ || 877 ||
analyzed: puṣkala sat śrī lakṣaṇa hṛdyaḥ yaḥ bahu virocana abhikhyaḥ vidyut bhājayatu hariḥ sa vṛtra saṃhanana bhidura vara hetiḥ

original: atra bhagavān prastutaḥ indrassūryaścandro vidyutprakāśaścāprastutāḥ | eteṣāṃ pañcānāṃ śleṣa iti pūrvodāharaṇādviśeṣaḥ | tathāhi, bhagavatpakṣe yaḥ hariḥ puṣkale atiśobhane satī ca sacca satī ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyām' iti napuṃsakaikaśeṣaḥ | satī abhyarhite ca |
analyzed: atra bhagavān prastutaḥ indraḥ sūryaḥ candraḥ vidyut prakāśaḥ ca aprastutāḥ eteṣām pañcānām śleṣaḥ iti pūrva udāharaṇāt viśeṣaḥ tathā hi bhagavat pakṣe yaḥ hariḥ puṣkale ati śobhane satī ca sat ca satī napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena eka vat ca asya anyatarasyām iti napuṃsaka ekaśeṣaḥ satī abhyarhite ca

original: śrīśca lakṣaṇaṃ ca śrīlakṣaṇe lakṣmīśrīvatsau hṛdye urassthite yasya saḥ 'śrīmān śreṣṭhaḥ puṣkalassyātsattamaścātiśobhane' ityamaraḥ | ‘satsādhau dhīraśastayoḥ | mānye satye vidyamāne triṣu sādhvyumayoḥ striyām' iti medinī | yadvā puṣkalāni pūrṇāni ‘pūrṇaśreṣṭhau tu puṣkalau' iti ratnamālā |
analyzed: śrīḥ ca lakṣaṇam ca śrī lakṣaṇe lakṣmī śrīvatsau hṛdye uras sthite yasya saḥ śrīmān śreṣṭhaḥ puṣkalaḥ syāt sattamaḥ ca ati śobhane iti amaraḥ sat sādhau dhīraśas tayoḥ mānye satye vidyamāne triṣu sādhvi umayoḥ striyām iti medinī yat vā puṣkalāni pūrṇāni pūrṇa śreṣṭhau tu puṣkalau iti ratnamālā

original: santi praśastāni lakṣaṇāni sāmudrikoktamahāpuruṣatvajñāpakāṅgacihnānvitaiḥ hṛdyaḥ manojñaḥ | yathocyate śrīrāmāyaṇādau
analyzed: santi praśastāni lakṣaṇāni sāmudrika ukta mahāpuruṣa tva jñāpaka aṅga cihna anvitaiḥ hṛdyaḥ manojñaḥ yathā ucyate śrī rāmāyaṇa ādau

original: tristhirastripralambaśca trisamastriṣu connataḥ |
analyzed: tri sthiraḥ tri pralambaḥ ca tri samaḥ triṣu ca unnataḥ

original: ityādinā | yadvā puṣkalā śrīmatī satī sādhvī ca yā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ tasyāḥ lakṣaṇaṃ nāmaiva hṛdyaḥ tasyāḥ jagato vā vaśīkāramantro yasya sa tathoktaḥ, hṛdayasya bandhano hṛdya iti vigrahaḥ| ‘bandhane carṣau' iti hṛdayaśabdāt ṣaṣṭhyantādbandhane yatpratyayo vede'bhidheye | hṛdyo vaśīkaraṇamantra ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: ityādinā yat vā puṣkalā śrīmatī satī sādhvī ca yā śrīḥ lakṣmīḥ tasyāḥ lakṣaṇam nāma eva hṛdyaḥ tasyāḥ jagataḥ vā vaśīkāra mantraḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ hṛdayasya bandhanaḥ hṛdyaḥ iti vigrahaḥ bandhane ca ṛṣau iti hṛdaya śabdāt ṣaṣṭhī antāt bandhane yad pratyayaḥ veda abhidheye hṛdyaḥ vaśīkaraṇa mantraḥ iti āhuḥ

original: ‘nārāyaṇasya kila nityajapastvadīyaṃ nāma pragalbhatamam' ityuktarītyā bhagavato lakṣmīnāma nityajapārhamiti bhāvaḥ |

original: iti ca vaijayantī | athavā puṣkarā satī śrīreva lakṣaṇaṃ jagadīśvaratvajñāpakamudrā hṛdyaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | bahu adhikaṃ virocanaṃ prakāśo yasyāstathoktā abhikhyā kīrtiryasya saḥ bahuvirocanābhikhyaḥ 'tasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ' iti śruteḥ | 'abhikhyā tviḍyaśonāmasu' iti ratnamālā |
analyzed: iti ca vaijayantī athavā puṣkarā satī śrīḥ eva lakṣaṇam jagat īśvara tva jñāpaka mudrā hṛdyam hṛdaya stham yasya sa tathā uktaḥ bahu adhikam virocanam prakāśaḥ yasyāḥ tathā uktā abhikhyā kīrtiḥ yasya saḥ bahu virocana abhikhyaḥ tasya nāma mahat yaśaḥ iti śruteḥ abhikhyā tviṣ yaśaḥ nāmasu iti ratnamālā

original: vṛtrasaṃhananabhiduravarahetiḥ vṛtrāśśatravaḥ teṣāṃ saṃhananāni vapūṃṣi ‘gātraṃ vapussaṃhananam' ityamaraḥ | bhindantīti bhidurāḥ 'vidibhidicchideḥ kurac' iti kurac | vṛtrasaṃhananānāṃ bhidurāḥ ripuvapurbhedinya ityarthaḥ | varāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ hetayaḥ sudarśanādīnyāyudhāni yasya saḥ | 'dhvāntāridānavā vṛtrāḥ|
analyzed: vṛtra saṃhanana bhidura vara hetiḥ vṛtrāḥ śatravaḥ teṣām saṃhananāni vapūṃṣi gātram vapuḥ saṃhananam iti amaraḥ bhindanti iti bhidurāḥ kurac iti kurac vṛtra saṃhananānām bhidurāḥ ripu vapuḥ bhedinyaḥ iti arthaḥ varāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ hetayaḥ sudarśana ādīni āyudhāni yasya saḥ dhvānta ari dānavāḥ vṛtrāḥ

original: vṛtro meghe ripau dhvānte dānave vāsave girau' ityamarahemacandrau | ‘hetirjvālāṃ'śurāyudham' iti vaijayantī | vidyudbhāḥ vidyuttulyaprakāśaḥ ‘sarve nimeṣā jajñire vidyutaḥ puruṣādadhi' iti śruteḥ | yadvā vit jñānaṃ 'vyavahāravide' ityādāviva videssaṃpadāditvādbhāve kvip | vidā yautīti vidyut | yudhātormiśraṇārthakātkartari kvip |
analyzed: vṛtraḥ meghe ripau dhvānte dānave vāsave girau iti amara hemacandrau hetiḥ jvālā aṃśuḥ āyudham iti vaijayantī vidyut bhās vidyut tulya prakāśaḥ sarve nimeṣāḥ jajñire vidyutaḥ puruṣāt adhi iti śruteḥ yat vā vid jñānam vyavahāra vide ityādau iva videḥ saṃpad ādi tvāt bhāve kvip vidā yauti iti vidyut yudhātoḥ miśraṇa arthakāt kartari kvip

original: ‘hrasvasya piti kṛti tuk' iti tugāgamaḥ | vidyut bhāḥ tejo yasya saḥ vidyudbhāḥ | jñānānvitatejassaṃpanna ityarthaḥ | atra
analyzed: hrasvasya p iti kṛti tuk iti tuk āgamaḥ vidyut bhās tejaḥ yasya saḥ vidyut bhās jñāna anvita tejaḥ saṃpannaḥ iti arthaḥ atra

original: jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ ||
analyzed: jñāna śakti bala aiśvarya vīrya tejāṃsi aśeṣatas

original: ityukteṣu guṇeṣu pratyāhāranyāyenādyantayorgrahaṇaṃ madhyasthānāṃ śaktyādīnāṃ caturṇāmapi guṇānāmupalakṣakam | tena pūrṇaṣāḍguṇyavattvaṃ darśitam | saḥ hariḥ jayatviti ||
analyzed: iti ukteṣu guṇeṣu pratyāhāra nyāyena ādi antayoḥ grahaṇam madhya sthānām śakti ādīnām caturṇām api guṇānām upalakṣakam tena pūrṇa ṣāḍguṇyavat tvam darśitam saḥ hariḥ jayatu iti

original: indrapakṣe yaḥ puṣkale puṣkare ralayorabhedāśrayaṇāt gagane sīdantīti puṣkarasadaḥ dyusadaḥ, sadeḥ kvip | teṣāṃ devānāṃ śrīlakṣaṇāni sāmrājyajñāpakacchatracāmarādicihnāni taiḥ hṛdyaḥ hṛdayapriyaḥ bahūni sahasrasaṃkhyākāni virocanāni vilocanāni ralayorabhedāśrayaṇāt yasya saḥ bahuvilocana ityabhikhyā prasiddhiḥ yasya sa tathokta iti bahuvrīhigarbho
analyzed: indra pakṣe yaḥ puṣkale puṣkare ralayoḥ abheda āśrayaṇāt gagane sīdanti iti puṣkarasadaḥ dyusadaḥ sadeḥ kvip teṣām devānām śrī lakṣaṇāni sāmrājya jñāpaka chatra cāmara ādi cihnāni taiḥ hṛdyaḥ hṛdaya priyaḥ bahūni sahasra saṃkhyākāni virocanāni vilocanāni ralayoḥ abheda āśrayaṇāt yasya saḥ bahu vilocanaḥ iti abhikhyā prasiddhiḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ iti bahuvrīhi garbhaḥ

original: bahuvrīhiḥ | vṛtrasya asuraviśeṣasya saṃhananaṃ hananasādhanaṃ hanteḥ karaṇe lyuṭ | yat bhiduraṃ kuliśaṃ 'bhiduraṃ paviḥ' ityamaraḥ | tadeva varahetiḥ uttamaśastraṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | vidyudbhāḥ vit vyākaraṇaviṣayakaṃ jñānaṃ ‘vāgvai parācyavyākṛtā'vadattāmindro madhyato'vakramya vyākarot' iti śruteḥ |
analyzed: bahuvrīhiḥ vṛtrasya asura viśeṣasya saṃhananam hanana sādhanam hanteḥ karaṇe lyuṭ yat bhiduram kuliśam bhiduram paviḥ iti amaraḥ tat eva vara hetiḥ uttama śastram yasya sa tathā uktaḥ vidyudbhāḥ vid vyākaraṇa viṣayakam jñānam vāc vai parācī avyākṛtā avadattām indraḥ madhyatas vakramya vyākarot iti śruteḥ

original: brahmaviṣayakaṃ jñānaṃ vā ‘sa hovāca māmeva vijānīhyetadevāhaṃ manuṣyāya hitatamaṃ manye' ityādinā pratardanāya svātmaśarīrakabrahmopadeṣṭṛtvaśravaṇāt | yut paulomādiyuddhaṃ tābhyāṃ bhāsata iti vidyudbhāḥ ‘samityājisamidyudhaḥ' ityamaraḥ | yadvā vidi udbhāḥ iticchedaḥ| vidi pūrvoktajñāne viṣaye udbhāḥ udañcaddīptiḥ apratihatajñāna ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: brahma viṣayakam jñānam vā sa ha uvāca mām eva vijānīhi etat eva aham manuṣyāya hitatamam manye ityādinā pratardanāya sva ātma śarīraka brahma upadeṣṭṛ tva śravaṇāt yud pauloma ādi yuddham tābhyām bhāsate iti vidyut bhās samiti āji samidh yudhaḥ iti amaraḥ yat vā vidi udbhās iti chedaḥ vidi pūrva ukta jñāne viṣaye udbhās udañcat dīptiḥ apratihata jñānaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: saḥ hariḥ indraḥ jayatviti ||
analyzed: saḥ hariḥ indraḥ jayatu iti

original: sūryapakṣe yaḥ puṣkarāṇāṃ kamalānāṃ satī yā śrīḥ saṃpat śobhā vā tasyāḥ lakṣaṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ralayorabhedāt | hṛdyaṃ hṛdayahitaṃ yasya saḥ | bahu iti bhinnaṃ padamagre'nveti | virocanābhikhyaḥ virocananāmā 'candrāgnyarkā virocanāḥ' ityamaraḥ | yadvā rocanānāṃ raktakahlārāṇāṃ abhikhyā śobhā | viśiṣṭā rocanābhikhyā yasmātsaḥ |
analyzed: sūrya pakṣe yaḥ puṣkarāṇām kamalānām satī yā śrīḥ saṃpad śobhā vā tasyāḥ lakṣaṇam rakṣaṇam ralayoḥ abhedāt hṛdyam hṛdaya hitam yasya saḥ bahu iti bhinnam padam agre nu eti virocana abhikhyaḥ virocana nāmā candra agni arkāḥ virocanāḥ iti amaraḥ yat vā rocanānām rakta kahlārāṇām abhikhyā śobhā viśiṣṭā rocana abhikhyā yasmāt saḥ

original: raktakahlārasuṣamāvaha ityarthaḥ | ‘rocanā raktakahlāre gavāṃ pitte varastriyām' iti ratnamālāvaijayantyau | bahu yathā syāttathā | idaṃ bhedanakriyāviśeṣaṇam | vṛtrāṇāṃ parjanyānāṃ saṃhananaṃ saṃghaḥ 'aṅge saṃghe saṃhananam' iti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: rakta kahlāra suṣamā vahaḥ iti arthaḥ rocanā rakta kahlāre gavām pitte vara striyām iti ratna mālā vaijayantyau bahu yathā syāt tathā idam bhedana kriyā viśeṣaṇam vṛtrāṇām parjanyānām saṃhananam saṃghaḥ aṅge saṃghe saṃhananam iti śeṣaḥ

original: teṣu bhidurāḥ vṛṣṭyarthaṃ militāḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ kiraṇāḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ ‘yābhirādityastapati raśmibhistābhiḥ parjanyo varṣati' iti śruteḥ | vidyudbhāḥ vidyudvarṇaḥ saḥ hariḥ sūryaḥ jayatviti ||
analyzed: teṣu bhidurāḥ vṛṣṭi artham militāḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ kiraṇāḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ yābhiḥ ādityaḥ tapati raśmibhiḥ tābhiḥ parjanyaḥ varṣati iti śruteḥ vidyut bhās vidyut varṇaḥ saḥ hariḥ sūryaḥ jayatu iti

original: candrapakṣe puṣkalaṃ pūrṇaṃ satāṃ rohiṇyādinakṣatrāṇāṃ ‘satklībamṛkṣe' iti ratnamālā | śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ hṛdyaṃ hṛdayapriyaṃ yasya saḥ | tārādhīśatvāttasyeti bhāvaḥ | yadvā bahu yathā tathā puṣkareṣu padmeṣu satī yā śrīḥ śobhā tasyāḥ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnaṃ nāma vā haratīti puṣkarasacchrīlakṣaṇahṛt, harateḥ kvip |
analyzed: candra pakṣe puṣkalam pūrṇam satām rohiṇī ādi nakṣatrāṇām sat klībam ṛkṣe iti ratnamālā śriyaḥ saṃpadaḥ rakṣaṇam hṛdyam hṛdaya priyam yasya saḥ tārā adhīśa tvāt tasya iti bhāvaḥ yat vā bahu yathā tathā puṣkareṣu padmeṣu satī yā śrīḥ śobhā tasyāḥ lakṣaṇam cihnam nāma vā harati iti puṣkara sat śrī lakṣaṇa hṛt harateḥ kvip

original: padmaśobhāyāścihnaṃ nāmāpi vā niśśeṣayitetyarthaḥ | asminpakṣe yaḥ puṣkarasacchrīlakṣaṇahṛt yaḥ virocanābhikhya iti yatpadadvayasya yojanā | virocanābhikhyaḥ cirocanāparanāmā | vṛtrāṇāṃ dhvāntānāṃ saṃhananasya saṃghasya bhidurāḥ bhedayitryaḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ aṃśavo yasya saḥ| vidyut viśeṣeṇa dyotamānā bhāḥ prabhāvo yasya saḥ |
analyzed: padma śobhāyāḥ cihnam nāma api vā niśśeṣayitā iti arthaḥ asmin pakṣe yaḥ puṣkara sat śrī lakṣaṇa hṛt yaḥ virocana abhikhyaḥ iti yat pada dvayasya yojanā virocana abhikhyaḥ cirocana apara nāmā vṛtrāṇām dhvāntānām saṃhananasya saṃghasya bhidurāḥ bhedayitryaḥ varāḥ hetayaḥ aṃśavaḥ yasya saḥ vidyut viśeṣeṇa dyotamānā bhās prabhāvaḥ yasya saḥ

original: uragadharādharakṛpā kartrī akhilān vinatān varān śreṣṭhān karoti varayati | varaśabdāṇṇic | eṣāṃ vinatānāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ ca uruṃ vipulaṃ karoti varayati | uruśabdāṇṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ‘priyasthira' ityādinā varādeśaḥ | tatra hetumāha kṣodayatītyādinā | yat yasmāt eṣā bhagavatkṛpā eṣāṃ vinatānāṃ ripūn kṣudrān kṛpaṇān karoti kṣodayati |
analyzed: uraga dharādhara kṛpā kartrī akhilān vinatān varān śreṣṭhān karoti varayati vara śabdāt ṇic eṣām vinatānām yaśaḥ kīrtim ca urum vipulam karoti varayati uru śabdāt ṇāv iṣṭhavat bhāve priya sthiraḥ ityādinā vara ādeśaḥ tatra hetum āha kṣodayati ityādinā yat yasmāt eṣā bhagavat kṛpā eṣām vinatānām ripūn kṣudrān kṛpaṇān karoti kṣodayati

original: kṣudraśabdāṇṇāviṣṭhavadbhāve ‘sthūladūra' ityādinā tasya yaṇādiparalopaḥ pūrvasya guṇaśca | tadīyāḥ vinataripusambandhinīḥ senāśca niśśeṣaṃ yathā syāt tathā kṣodaṃ karoti kṣodayati | kṣodaśabdāṇṇic | cūrṇayatītyarthaḥ | ‘cūrṇe kṣodaḥ' ityamaraḥ | atra varoruśabdayoḥ kṣudrakṣodaśabdayośca ṇijantayostipyaikarūpyātprakṛtiśleṣaḥ ||
analyzed: sthūla dūre ityādinā tasya ya ṇa ādi para lopaḥ pūrvasya guṇaḥ ca tadīyāḥ vinataripu sambandhinīḥ senāḥ ca niśśeṣam yathā syāt tathā kṣodam karoti kṣodayati kṣoda śabdāt ṇic cūrṇayati iti arthaḥ cūrṇe kṣodaḥ iti amaraḥ atra vara ūru śabdayoḥ kṣudra kṣoda śabdayoḥ ca ṇic antayoḥ tipi aikarūpyāt prakṛti śleṣaḥ

original: amīṣāmaṣṭānāṃ śleṣāṇāṃ madhye yasya yasminnantarbhāvaḥ pratibhāti tatra tadbhinnatvaṃ vivakṣaṇīyam' ityalaṅkārakaustubhakāraḥ | ete śleṣabhedāḥ prāgupadarśiteṣu prakṛtāprakṛtādiśleṣodāharaṇeṣvapi yathāyathaṃ saṃbhavantīti dhyeyam | evaṃ aṣṭavidhassabhaṅgaśleṣo nirūpitaḥ | abhaṅgaśleṣo yathā, madīya eva nṛsiṃhavilāse
analyzed: amīṣām aṣṭānām śleṣāṇām madhye yasya yasmin antarbhāvaḥ pratibhāti tatra tad bhinna tvam vivakṣaṇīyam iti alaṅkārakaustubha kāraḥ ete śleṣa bhedāḥ prāk upadarśiteṣu prakṛta aprakṛta ādi śleṣa udāharaṇeṣu api yathāyatham saṃbhavanti iti dhyeyam evam aṣṭavidhaḥ sa bhaṅga śleṣaḥ nirūpitaḥ abhaṅga śleṣaḥ yathā madīye eva nṛsiṃha vilāse

original: amṛtaśriyaṃ prayacchan satāṃ pravardhitahiraṇyagarbho yaḥ | mugdhendubimbadhāmā mukhe harisstānmude mahān sa pumān || 930 ||
analyzed: amṛta śriyam prayacchan satām pravardhita hiraṇyagarbhaḥ yaḥ mugdha indu bimba dhāmā mukhe hariḥ stād mude mahān sa pumān

original: atra śrīhayagrīvanṛsiṃhayorubhayorapi stavyatvena prastutayoreva śleṣaḥ | yaḥ satāṃ amṛtaśriyaṃ trayīmityarthaḥ | 'ṛcassāmāni yajūgm̐ṣi | sā hi śrīramṛtā satām' iti śruteḥ | prayacchan pradānena hetunā ‘lakṣaṇahetvoḥ' iti śatā |
analyzed: atra śrī hayagrīva nṛsiṃhayoḥ ubhayoḥ api stavya tvena prastutayoḥ eva śleṣaḥ yaḥ satām amṛta śriyam trayīm iti arthaḥ ṛcaḥ sāmāni yaju gm̐ṣi sā hi śrīḥ amṛtā satām iti śruteḥ prayacchan pradānena hetunā lakṣaṇa hetvoḥ iti śatā

original: pravardhitaḥ samedhitaḥ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ brahmā yena saḥ madhukaiṭabhāpahṛtavedāharaṇatatpradānojjīvitacaturmukha ityarthaḥ | ‘yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti tasmai' iti śruteḥ | atra mokṣadharmagatahayaśiraupākhyānamanusandheyam |
analyzed: pravardhitaḥ samedhitaḥ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ brahmā yena saḥ madhu kaiṭabha apahṛta veda āharaṇa tad pradāna ujjīvita caturmukhaḥ iti arthaḥ yaḥ brahmāṇam vidadhāti pūrvam yaḥ vai vedān ca prahiṇoti tasmai iti śruteḥ atra mokṣadharma gata hayaśiraḥ upākhyānam anusandheyam

original: pakṣe satāṃ brahmavidāṃ amṛtaśriyaṃ muktisaṃpadaṃ prayacchan pravardhitaḥ prakarṣeṇa chinnaḥ hiraṇyasya hiraṇyakaśipoḥ garbhaḥ kukṣiḥ yena sa tathā | mugdhendubivaṃ dhāma sthānaṃ yasya, pakṣe mugdhendubimbasya dhāmeva dhāma tejaḥ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | nṛsiṃhadivyavigrahasya ‘indudhavalaṃ lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ bhaje' iti pāṇḍuratvokteḥ |
analyzed: pakṣe satām brahma vidām amṛta śriyam mukti saṃpadam prayacchan pravardhitaḥ prakarṣeṇa chinnaḥ hiraṇyasya hiraṇyakaśipoḥ garbhaḥ kukṣiḥ yena sa tathā mugdha indu bivam dhāma sthānam yasya pakṣe mugdha indu bimbasya dhāma iva dhāma tejaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ nṛsiṃha divya vigrahasya indu dhavalam lakṣmī nṛsiṃham bhaje iti pāṇḍura tva ukteḥ

original: mukhe hariḥ turaṅgaḥ siṃhaśca sa mahān mude astu | atrānyonyavilakṣaṇaṃ padabhaṅgamanapekṣya samānānupūrvīkaśabdapratisandhānabodhyānekārthakroḍīkaraṇādabhaṅgaśleṣaḥ ||
analyzed: mukhe hariḥ turaṅgaḥ siṃhaḥ ca sa mahān mude astu atra anyonya vilakṣaṇam pada bhaṅgam an apekṣya samāna ānupūrvīka śabda pratisandhāna bodhya aneka artha kroḍīkaraṇāt abhaṅga śleṣaḥ

original: atra kecid anayossabhaṅgābhaṅgaśleṣayoḥ ‘sarvadomādhavaḥ' ityādau sarvadaḥ sarvadeti padadvayasya jatukāṣṭhanyāyena saṃbandhātsabhaṅgaśleṣaśśabdālaṅkāraḥ, śabdavṛttitvāt |
analyzed: atra kecid anayoḥ sa bhaṅga abhaṅga śleṣayoḥ sarvadaḥ mādhavaḥ ityādau sarva daḥ sarvadā iti pada dvayasya jatu kāṣṭha nyāyena saṃbandhāt sa bhaṅga śleṣaḥ śabdālaṅkāraḥ śabda vṛtti tvāt

original: abhaṅgaśleṣastu abjakamalādiśabdeṣu padabhedābhāvena padadvayasaṃbandhābhāvācchabdavṛttitānupapatterekasmin śabde arthadvayasya vācyatayā saṃbaddhatvādayamekavṛntagataphaladvayanyāyenārthālaṅkāra ityāhuḥ ||
analyzed: abhaṅga śleṣaḥ tu abja kamala ādi śabdeṣu pada bheda abhāvena pada dvaya saṃbandha abhāvāt śabda vṛtti tā anupapatteḥ ekasmin śabde artha dvayasya vācya tayā saṃbaddha tvāt ayam eka vṛnta gata phala dvaya nyāyena artha alaṅkāraḥ iti āhuḥ

original: anye tu sabhaṅgābhaṅgaśleṣau dvāvapi śabdālaṅkārāveva, śabdānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt | na tu sabhaṅgaśleṣasya śabdāśritatvācchabdaśleṣatvaṃ abhaṅgaśleṣasyārthāśritatvādarthaśleṣatvaṃ yuktaṃ, kaṣṭatvādidoṣagāḍhatvādiguṇānuprāsādyalaṅkāravadatrāpyanvayavyatirekābhyāmeva vyavasthopapattāvatiriktaniyāmakāntarakalpane gauravāt |
analyzed: anye tu sa bhaṅga abhaṅga śleṣau dvau api śabda alaṅkārau eva śabda anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt na tu sa bhaṅga śleṣasya śabda āśrita tvāt śabda śleṣa tvam abhaṅga śleṣasya artha āśrita tvāt artha śleṣa tvam yuktam kaṣṭa tva ādi doṣa gāḍha tva ādi guṇa anuprāsa ādi alaṅkāra vat atra api anvaya vyatirekābhyām eva vyavasthā upapattau atirikta niyāmaka antara kalpane gauravāt

original: na caivamabhaṅgaśleṣasyāpi śabdānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitayā śabdaśleṣatve arthaśleṣo nirviṣayassyāditi vācyaṃ,
analyzed: na ca evam abhaṅga śleṣasya api śabda anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tayā śabda śleṣa tve artha śleṣaḥ nirviṣayaḥ syāt iti vācyam

original: stokenonnatimāyāti stokenāyātyadhogatim |
analyzed: stokena unnatim āyāti stokena āyāti adhogatim

original: aho susadṛśī rītistulākoṭeḥ khalasya ca ||
analyzed: aho su sadṛśī rītiḥ tulā koṭeḥ khalasya ca

original: ityādau yatra svalpenonnatimāyātītyādinā śabdaparivartane'pi na śleṣatvabhaṅgaḥ | tatraivārthaśleṣapadavīsāmrājyādityavādiṣuḥ ||
analyzed: ityādau yatra su alpena unnatim āyāti ityādinā śabda parivartane api na śleṣa tva bhaṅgaḥ tatra eva artha śleṣa padavī sāmrājyāt iti avādiṣuḥ

original: kuvalayānandakṛtastu ubhayamapyarthālaṅkāra iti | ayaṃ hi teṣāmāśayaḥ sabhaṅgābhaṅgabhedena dvividho'pyayaṃ śleṣo'rthālaṅkāra eva, anekārthapratipādanātmanastasyārthālaṅkāratvasyaivocitatvāt | āśrayāśrayibhāvasyaiva laukikālaṅkāravattattadalaṅkāraprayojakatvam |
analyzed: kuvalayānanda kṛtaḥ tu ubhayam api arthālaṅkāraḥ iti ayam hi teṣām āśayaḥ sa bhaṅga abhaṅga bhedena dvividhaḥ upi ayam śleṣa ūrthālaṅkāraḥ eva aneka artha pratipādana ātmanaḥ tasya arthālaṅkāra tvasya eva ucitatvāt āśraya āśrayi bhāvasya eva laukika alaṅkāra vat tad tad alaṅkāra prayojaka tvam

original: laukikālaṅkāro hi kaṅkaṇamañjīrādiḥ pāṇipādādiniṣṭhaḥ pāṇipādādyalaṅkāratayaiva vyavahriyate | iyameva rītiḥ kāvyagatālaṅkāreṣvapi | na ca śabdānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvādasya śabdālaṅakāratvamiti vācyam | tathā sati sarveṣāmapyalaṅkārāṇāṃ tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvena śabdālaṅkāratāprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: laukika alaṅkāraḥ hi kaṅkaṇa mañjīra ādiḥ pāṇi pāda ādi niṣṭhaḥ pāṇi pāda ādi alaṅkāratayā eva vyavahriyate iyam eva rītiḥ kāvya gata alaṅkāreṣu api na ca śabda anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt asya śabda alaṅakāra tvam iti vācyam tathā sati sarveṣām api alaṅkārāṇām tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvena śabda alaṅkāra tā prasaṅgāt

original: na cābhaṅgaśleṣasya ekavṛntagataphaladvayanyāyena ekapadāśritārthadvayaniṣṭhatayā'rthālaṅkāratvaṃ, sabhaṅgasya tu jatukāṣṭhanyāyena śabdadvayasaṃśleṣarūpatvācchabdālaṅkāratvamiti sarvasvakārādyaktaṃ yuktaṃ, 'arthabhedena śabdabhedaḥ' iti mate ‘anyāyyaṃ cānekārthatvam' ityupapattikabalite abhaṅgaśleṣe'pi sabhaṅga iva śabdabhedasya durnivāratayā
analyzed: na ca abhaṅga śleṣasya eka vṛnta gata phala dvaya nyāyena eka pada āśrita artha dvaya niṣṭhatayā artha alaṅkāra tvam sabhaṅgasya tu jatu kāṣṭha nyāyena śabda dvaya saṃśleṣa rūpa tvāt śabda alaṅkāra tvam iti sarva sva kāra ādi aktam yuktam artha bhedena śabda bhedaḥ iti mate anyāyyam ca aneka artha tvam iti upapatti kabalite abhaṅga śleṣe api sabhaṅge iva śabdabhedasya durnivāra tayā

original: śabdayoreva śleṣasya suvacatvāt | ata ubhayaṃ śabdālaṅkāra iti vā sabhaṅgasya śabdālaṅkāratvamabhaṅgasyārthālaṅkāratvamiti vā matadvayamapyayuktam | tasmāt dvayorapyarthālaṅkāratvameva yuktamiti |
analyzed: śabdayoḥ eva śleṣasya suvaca tvāt atas ubhayam śabdālaṅkāraḥ iti vā sabhaṅgasya śabda alaṅkāra tvam abhaṅgasya artha alaṅkāra tvam iti vā mata dvayam api ayuktam tasmāt dvayoḥ api artha alaṅkāra tvam eva yuktam iti

original: anye tu camatkāre arthamukhaprekṣitvādubhayorapyarthālaṃkāratvaṃ, anuprāsayamakādestu na camatkāre'rthamukhaprekṣitvamiti na teṣāmarthālaṃkāratvaṃ apitu śabdavaicitryācchabdālaṃkāratvamevetyapyāhuḥ ||
analyzed: anye tu camatkāre artha mukha prekṣi tvāt ubhayoḥ api artha alaṃkāra tvam anuprāsa yamaka ādeḥ tu na camatkāra ūrtha mukha prekṣi tvam iti na teṣām artha alaṃkāra tvam apitu śabda vaicitryāt śabda alaṃkāra tvam eva iti api āhuḥ

original: kāvyaprakāśānuyāyī jagannāthastu " śrutyaikayā'nekārthapratipādanaṃ śleṣaḥ | tacca dvedhānekadharmapuraskāreṇa ekadharmapuraskāreṇa ca | ādyaṃ dvedhānekaśabdapratibhānadvārā ekaśabdapratibhānadvārā ceti trividhaśśleṣaḥ | tatrādyassabhaṅgaḥ dvitīyo'bhaṅga iti vadanti | tṛtīyastu śuddhaḥ |
analyzed: kāvya prakāśa anuyāyī jagannāthaḥ tu śrutyā ekayā aneka artha pratipādanam śleṣaḥ tat ca dvedhā aneka dharma puraskāreṇa eka dharma puraskāreṇa ca ādyam dvedhā aneka śabda pratibhāna dvārā eka śabda pratibhāna dvārā ca iti trividhaḥ śleṣaḥ tatra ādyaḥ sa bhaṅgaḥ dvitīyaḥ bhaṅgaḥ iti vadanti tṛtīyaḥ tu śuddhaḥ

original: evaṃ trividho'pyayaṃ prakṛtamātrāprakṛtamātraprakṛtāprakṛtobhayāśritatvena punastrividhaḥ | tatrādye bhede dvitīye ca viśeṣyasya śliṣṭatāyāṃ kāmacāraḥ | tṛtīyabhede tu viśeṣaṇavācakasyaiva śliṣṭatvaṃ na viśeṣyavācakasya tathātve śabdaśaktimūladhvaneruccheda eva syāt | viśeṣaṇamātraśliṣṭatāyāmapi prakṛtāprakṛtadharmiṇorupādāna eva śleṣaḥ |
analyzed: evam trividhaḥ upi ayam prakṛta mātra aprakṛta mātra prakṛta aprakṛta ubhaya āśrita tvena punar trividhaḥ tatra ādye bhede dvitīye ca viśeṣyasya śliṣṭa tāyām kāmacāraḥ tṛtīya bhede tu viśeṣaṇa vācakasya eva śliṣṭa tvam na viśeṣya vācakasya tathātve śabda śakti mūla dhvaneḥ ucchedaḥ eva syāt viśeṣaṇa mātra śliṣṭa tāyām api prakṛta aprakṛta dharmiṇoḥ upādāne eva śleṣaḥ

original: prakṛtadharmimātrasyopādāne tu samāsoktereva viṣayaḥ | taditthaṃ prakṛtamātraviśeṣyakānekārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ yatra sa ekaḥ | evamaprakṛtetyādi dvitīyaḥ | pṛthagupāttaprakṛtāprakṛtobhayaviśeṣyakanānārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ tṛtīyaḥ | etadanyatamatvaṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ paryavasitam" ityabhāṇīt | tanmatānusāreṇa diṅmātramudāhriyate
analyzed: prakṛta dharmi mātrasya upādāne tu samāsokteḥ eva viṣayaḥ tat ittham prakṛta mātra viśeṣyaka aneka artha viśeṣaṇam yatra saḥ ekaḥ evam aprakṛta ityādi dvitīyaḥ pṛthak upātta prakṛta aprakṛta ubhaya viśeṣyaka nānā artha viśeṣaṇam tṛtīyaḥ etad anyatama tvam ca lakṣaṇam paryavasitam iti abhāṇīt tad mata anusāreṇa diś mātram udāhriyate

original: tatrādyaḥ prakṛtamātraviṣayassabhaṅgaḥ śleṣo yathā
analyzed: tatra ādyaḥ prakṛta mātra viṣayaḥ sa bhaṅgaḥ śleṣaḥ yathā

original: jagadavati yasya pāṇissubhavyabhāvetrasattayā dīvyan | śeṣāhāryādaraṇo viṣvaksenassa śamayatādvighnān || 931 ||
analyzed: jagat avati yasya pāṇiḥ su bhavya bhāva itra sat tayā dīvyan śeṣa āhārya ādaraṇaḥ viṣvaksenaḥ sa śamayatāt vighnān

original: yasya bhagavataḥ pāṇiḥ trasato bhāvaḥ trasattā na trasattā atrasattā tayā anudvignatayā subhavyasya jagatkṣemasya bhāve prāptau viṣaye ‘bhū prāptāvātmanepadī' ityādhṛṣīyādbhavaterghañ | dīvyan jagat avati |
analyzed: yasya bhagavataḥ pāṇiḥ trasataḥ bhāvaḥ trasat tā na trasat tā a trasat tā tayā anudvigna tayā su bhavyasya jagat kṣemasya bhāve prāptau viṣaye bhū prāptau ātmanepadī iti ādhṛṣīyāt bhavateḥ ghañ dīvyan jagat avati

original: pakṣe yasya bhagavatsenādhināthasya viṣvaksenasya subhavyā atiramaṇīyā bhāḥ dīptiryasya saḥ pāṇiḥ vetrasya sattayā sthityā prāśastyena vā dīvyan jagadavati ‘yadvetraśikharaspande viśvametadvyavasthitam' ityukteḥ | śeṣāhārye śeṣādrau ādaraṇaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ | pakṣe śeṣe anante ahāryaṃ itarairanapanodyaṃ ādaraṇaṃ yasya sa tathā |
analyzed: pakṣe yasya bhagavat senā adhināthasya viṣvaksenasya su bhavyā ati ramaṇīyā bhāḥ dīptiḥ yasya saḥ pāṇiḥ vetrasya sattayā sthityā prāśastyena vā dīvyan jagat avati yat vetra śikhara spande viśvam etat vyavasthitam iti ukteḥ śeṣa āhārye śeṣa adrau ādaraṇam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ pakṣe śeṣe anante ahāryam itaraiḥ anapanodyam ādaraṇam yasya sa tathā

original: svasyeva tasyāpi nityasiddhatayā tasminnavicchinnaprītiriti bhāvaḥ | saḥ viṣvakseno bhagavān 'viṣvaksenaścaturbhujaḥ' ityamaraḥ | pakṣe bhagavatsenānīḥ vighnān vidyāniṣpattivirodhino'ntarāyān aihikaśreyontarāyāṃśca śamayatāt | ‘śuklāmbaradharaṃ, yasya dvirada' iti padyābhyāmubhayorapi vighnopaśamanārthamupāsyatvābhidhānāt |
analyzed: svasya iva tasya api nitya siddha tayā tasmin avicchinna prītiḥ iti bhāvaḥ saḥ viṣvaksenaḥ bhagavān viṣvaksenaḥ caturbhujaḥ iti amaraḥ pakṣe bhagavat senā nīḥ vighnān vidyā niṣpatti virodhinaḥ ntarāyān aihika śreyaḥ ntarāyān ca śamayatāt śukla ambara dharam yasya dviradaḥ iti padyābhyām ubhayoḥ api vighna upaśamana artham upāsya tva abhidhānāt

original: atra bhagavadviṣvaksenayorubhayorapi prakṛtatvāt prakṛtamātrāśrito'yamekayā śrutyā padadvayapratibhānadvārā bhinnadharmapuraskāreṇānekārthapratipādanātsabhaṅgaḥ ||
analyzed: atra bhagavat viṣvaksenayoḥ ubhayoḥ api prakṛta tvāt prakṛta mātra āśritaḥ yam ekayā śrutyā pada dvaya pratibhāna dvārā bhinna dharma puraskāreṇa aneka artha pratipādanāt sabhaṅgaḥ

original: viśeṣyayoraśliṣṭatve'pyayaṃ saṃbhavati, yathā
analyzed: viśeṣyayoḥ aśliṣṭa tve pi ayam saṃbhavati yathā

original: bahudhāmaravidrāvaṇaparāsuhṛdbāṇabhujavitatilavitā | bhṛgunetā raghunetā yadunetā vā mamāvitā bhavitā || 932 ||
analyzed: bahudhā amara vidrāvaṇa para asu hṛd bāṇa bhujavita tilavitā bhṛgunetā raghunetā yadunetā vā mamāvitā bhavitā

original: drāvayatīti drāvaṇaḥ raveḥ drāvaṇaḥ ravidrāvaṇaḥ | bahunā dhāmnā tejasā ravidrāvaṇaḥ vahnineva svarṇapiṇḍaṃ svatejasā vilāpayatītyarthaḥ | mahāpratāpaśālīti bhāvaḥ | yathocyate mātsyādiṣu purāṇeṣu

original: hrādinyāḥ nadyāḥ, pakṣe hrādinyā taṭitā | antaḥ vilasan 'taṭinī hrādinī dhunī, hrādinyau vajrataṭitau' iti cāmaraḥ | alaṃ sāraṅgāṇāṃ bhṛṅgāṇāṃ ullāsadāyī yo rasaḥ makarandaḥ taṃ dadātīti sāraṅgollāsadāyirasadam | pakṣe sāraṅgāṇāṃ cātakānāṃ 'sāraṅgaścātake bhṛṅge' iti śeṣaḥ | ullāsadāyi idaṃ bhinnaṃ padam | rasat amalamiti chedaḥ |
analyzed: hrādinyāḥ nadyāḥ pakṣe hrādinyā taṭitā antar vilasan taṭinī hrādinī dhunī hrādinyau vajra taṭitau iti ca amaraḥ alam sāraṅgāṇām bhṛṅgāṇām ullāsa dāyī yaḥ rasaḥ makarandaḥ tam dadāti iti sāraṅga ullāsa dāyi rasa dam pakṣe sāraṅgāṇām cātakānām sāraṅgaḥ cātake bhṛṅge iti śeṣaḥ ullāsa dāyi idam bhinnam padam rasat amalam iti chedaḥ

original: rasat garjat amalaṃ akaluṣaṃ atisnigdhamityarthaḥ | nīlaṃ kuvalayaṃ indīvaraṃ ambhodavalayaṃ ca haribhāsā paribhūtam | atra prathame pāde abhaṅgaḥ dvitīye sabhaṅgaḥ nīlamityatra śuddhaśca śleṣaḥ aśliṣṭaviśeṣyakaḥ ||
analyzed: rasat garjat amalam akaluṣam ati snigdham iti arthaḥ nīlam kuvalayam indīvaram ambhoda valayam ca hari bhāsā paribhūtam atra prathame pāde abhaṅgaḥ dvitīye sa bhaṅgaḥ nīlam iti atra śuddhaḥ ca śleṣaḥ aśliṣṭa viśeṣyakaḥ

analyzed: hṛdya mahā padma śrīḥ nīla ruciḥ kunda sahaja vara śaṅkhaḥ dhanadaḥ iva kanati śauriḥ viyat dhunī vimala vṛṣa girīśa āptaḥ hṛdyā vakṣaḥ sthā mahāpadmā mahatī pūjye padme kara dhṛte yasyāḥ sā tathā uktā śrīḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ pakṣe hṛdyā hṛdaya priyā mahā padma śrīḥ mahāpadma ākhya nidhi saṃpad yasya sa tathā

original: viyaddhunyā ākāśagaṅgayā vimalaḥ vigamitajagatkaluṣo yo vṛṣa iti girīśaḥ adrivaraḥ tena āptaḥ prāptaḥ saḥ āpto yeneti vā | pakṣe viyaddhunī gaṅgeva vimalo viśadaḥ vṛṣaḥ vṛṣabho yasya sa tathoktaḥ | girīśo rudraḥ āptaḥ pratyayito yasya saḥ tasyāpta iti vā ‘āptapratyayitau samau' ityamaraḥ | tryambakasakha ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: viyaddhunyā ākāśagaṅgayā vimalaḥ vigamita jagat kaluṣaḥ yaḥ vṛṣaḥ iti girīśaḥ adri varaḥ tena āptaḥ prāptaḥ saḥ āptaḥ yena iti vā pakṣe viyat dhunī gaṅgā iva vimalaḥ viśadaḥ vṛṣaḥ vṛṣabhaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ girīśaḥ rudraḥ āptaḥ pratyayitaḥ yasya saḥ tasya āptaḥ iti vā āpta pratyayitau samau iti amaraḥ tryambaka sakhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: bhagavān śrīnivāsaḥ dhanadaḥ kubera iva kanati dīpyate | atra prakṛtāprakṛtayoḥ bhagavaddhanadayoraśliṣṭatvādviśeṣaṇānāṃ ca śliṣṭatvādbhavati tṛtīyo bhedaḥ | paraṃ tvayamupamayā saṃkīrṇaḥ |
analyzed: bhagavān śrīnivāsaḥ dhanadaḥ kuberaḥ iva kanati dīpyate atra prakṛta aprakṛtayoḥ bhagavat dhanadayoḥ aśliṣṭa tvāt viśeṣaṇānām ca śliṣṭa tvāt bhavati tṛtīyaḥ bhedaḥ param tu ayam upamayā saṃkīrṇaḥ

original: yadi ca bhagavān dhanado vilasatīti paṭhitvā aprakṛtāṃśamapi śleṣagrastaṃ vidhāya rūpakaṃ kriyate tadā'pi prakṛtaviśeṣyasya śaureraśliṣṭatvādakhaṇḍita eva śleṣaḥ | na cātra samāsoktiriti bhramitavyaṃ, aprakṛtadharmiṇo'pi śabdavācyatvāt | yatra tvaprakṛtavyavahāra eva śabdaśaktiṃ sahetāpi na tvaprakṛtadharmī tatra samasokteriṣṭeḥ ||
analyzed: yadi ca bhagavān dhanadaḥ vilasati iti paṭhitvā aprakṛta aṃśam api śleṣa grastam vidhāya rūpakam kriyate tadā api prakṛta viśeṣyasya śaureḥ aśliṣṭa tvāt akhaṇḍitaḥ eva śleṣaḥ na ca atra samāsoktiḥ iti bhramitavyam aprakṛta dharmiṇaḥ api śabda vācya tvāt yatra tu aprakṛta vyavahāraḥ eva śabda śaktim saheta api na tu aprakṛta dharmī tatra samasokteḥ iṣṭeḥ

original: atra vicāryate’yaṃ cālaṃkāraḥ prāyeṇālaṃkārāntarasya viṣayamabhiniviśate | tatra kimasya bādhakatvaṃ syāt āhosvitsaṃkīrṇatvaṃ utāho bādhyatvamiti | atrāhurudbhaṭādayaḥ "yena nāprāpte ya ārabhyate sa tasya bādhakaḥ" iti nyāyenālaṃkārāntaraviṣaya evāyamārabhyamāṇo'laṃkārāntaraṃ bādhate na cāsya viviktaḥ kaścidasti viṣayaḥ |
analyzed: atra vicāryateyam ca alaṃkāraḥ prāyeṇa alaṃkāra antarasya viṣayam abhiniviśate tatra kim asya bādhaka tvam syāt āhosvit saṃkīrṇa tvam uta aho bādhya tvam iti atra āhuḥ udbhaṭa ādayaḥ yena na aprāpte yaḥ ārabhyate sa tasya bādhakaḥ iti nyāyena alaṃkāra antara viṣayaḥ eva ayam ārabhyamāṇa ulaṃkāra antaram bādhate na ca asya viviktaḥ kaścid asti viṣayaḥ

original: yatra labdhāvakāśo netaraṃ bādheta | tathāhi aprakṛtamātrayoḥ prakṛtamātrayorvā tāvattulyayogitaiva jāgarti prakṛtāprakṛtayostu dīpakam | tadanumoditā upamādayaśca | na ca
analyzed: yatra labdha avakāśaḥ na itaram bādheta tathā hi aprakṛta mātrayoḥ prakṛta mātrayoḥ vā tāvat tulya yogitā eva jāgarti prakṛta aprakṛtayoḥ tu dīpakam tad anumoditāḥ upamā ādayaḥ ca na ca

original: ityādikāvyaprakāśoktau vivakto viṣaya iti vācyaṃ, rūpakasyaivātra sphuṭatvāt | śleṣopasthāpitapātālādyarthasyābhedāropamantareṇa lokatrayātmakatvasya durupapādatvāt | kathaṃ tarhi ‘nadīnāṃ saṃpadaṃ bibhradrājā'yaṃ sāgaro yathā' ityādāvupamāyāḥ pratyayaḥ | kathaṃ vā tatraiva yathāśabdasthāne kimuśabdadāne utprekṣāyāḥ |
analyzed: iti ādi kāvya prakāśa uktau vivaktaḥ viṣayaḥ iti vācyam rūpakasya eva atra sphuṭa tvāt śleṣa upasthāpita pātāla ādi arthasya abheda āropam antareṇa lokatraya ātmaka tvasya durupapāda tvāt katham tarhi nadīnām saṃpadam bibhrat rājā ayam sāgaraḥ yathā ityādau upamāyāḥ pratyayaḥ katham vā tatra eva yathā śabda sthāne kimu śabda dāne utprekṣāyāḥ

original: apara iti kṛte ca rūpakasyeti cenna | atra hi upamādīnāṃ pratibhānamātraṃ, na tu vāstavī sthitiḥ | na hi śvaityena śuktau rajatatvaṃ pratīyamānamapi vastuto'sti | tasmādupamādipratibhotpattihetuśśleṣa eva svaviṣaye sarvatrālaṃkāra iti ||
analyzed: apare iti kṛte ca rūpakasya iti ced na atra hi upamā ādīnām pratibhāna mātram na tu vāstavī sthitiḥ na hi śvaityena śuktau rajata tvam pratīyamānam api vastutas sti tasmāt upamā ādi pratibhā utpatti hetuḥ śleṣaḥ eva sva viṣaye sarvatra alaṃkāraḥ iti

original: atrāprastutamarālavṛttāntena bhagavattadanyaparasiddhāntadvayasyāpi tulyatayā svīkartuḥ kasyacidbahuśākhamateḥ kovidaṃmanyasya guṇaprakhyāpanapūrvakamupālambho dyotyaḥ |

analyzed: ime vaṭāḥ nyagrodha taravaḥ vakṣyamāṇa rītyā phala kāminaḥ iti ca vyajyate śākhinaḥ śākhā śālinaḥ jaṭālāḥ api śiphā anvitāḥ ca santaḥ nīrase rasa vidhure phale svakīya phale raktāḥ śoṇa varṇāḥ bhavanti prasiddhi ati hi tādvidhyam tad phalānām pakṣe śākhinaḥ veda bhāga adhyetāraḥ jaṭālāḥ jaṭā anvitāḥ tāpasāḥ api iti arthaḥ

original: ‘śākhāpakṣāntare bāhau vedabhāgadrubhāgayoḥ' iti, ‘jaṭālagnakace mūle' iti ca medinī | nīrase tucchānande phale paśuputrasvargādiprayojane raktāḥ āsaktāḥ bhavanti | tatphalakāmaiḥ tathāvidhanīrasaphalakāmaireva patatāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ, adhaḥpātināṃ janānāṃ ca stomaiḥ vrajaiḥ niṣevyante ca | bateti tadanaucityacintanajanitakhede |
analyzed: śākhā pakṣa antare bāhau vedabhāga drubhāgayoḥ iti jaṭā lagna kace mūle iti ca medinī nīrase tuccha ānande phale paśu putra svarga ādi prayojane raktāḥ āsaktāḥ bhavanti tad phala kāmaiḥ tathāvidha nīrasa phala kāmaiḥ eva patatām pakṣiṇām adhaḥpātinām janānām ca stomaiḥ vrajaiḥ niṣevyante ca bata iti tad anaucitya cintana janita khede

original: atra nyagrodhānāṃ ślāghanapūrvakanindanahetutayopāttaṃ viśeṣaṇamasaṃbhavi | na hi śākhitvaṃ jaṭālatvaṃ ca ślāghanahetuḥ, nāpi śoṇavarṇanīrasaphalatvaṃ tādṛśaphalasaktavihaganiṣevyatvaṃ ca nindanahetuḥ, yena tādṛgguṇaślāghanapūrvakaṃ te nindyeran | ato vācyārthasya upapāditarītyā vyajyamānatādātmyaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇāṃśayorapekṣyate pūrvavat ||
analyzed: atra nyagrodhānām ślāghana pūrvaka nindana hetutayā upāttam viśeṣaṇam asaṃbhavi na hi śākhi tvam jaṭāla tvam ca ślāghana hetuḥ nā api śoṇa varṇa nīrasa phala tvam tādṛśa phala sakta vihaga niṣevya tvam ca nindana hetuḥ yena tādṛś guṇa ślāghana pūrvakam te nindyeran atas vācyārthasya upapādita rītyā vyajyamāna tādātmyam viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa aṃśayoḥ apekṣyate pūrvavat

original: vāriṇi salile muhuḥ śāśvat uditāḥ utsṛtvarāḥ bhaṅgāḥ taraṅgāḥ yeṣāṃ tān | anyatra balasya sāmarthyasya bhāvaḥ sattā atiśayitaḥ balabhāvo yeṣāṃ te atibalabhāvāḥ ye arayaḥ vairiṇaḥ daityādayaḥ taiḥ muhuḥ asakṛt uditaḥ bhaṅgaḥ parābhavo yeṣāṃ tān | spaṣṭamanyat |

original: vātāśanaiḥ vyālaiḥ munibhiśca anuyātāṃ upāśritāṃ sūnānāṃ prasūnānāṃ śriyā samṛddhyā sūnayā sutarāṃ ūnayā hīnayā śriyā saṃpadā ativikhyātāṃ paradevatāpekṣayā atyalpavaibhaveti jagadviditāmityarthaḥ | atra kasyacitpuruṣasya paradevatetarakṣudradevatābhajanaṃ tava niṣphalamiti dyotyam |

original: tatra vācyapratīyamānayoḥ ketakīkṣudradevatayorubhayorapi bhajanānaucitye hetutayopāttaṃ viśeṣaṇamasaṃbhavi | yasmāt sūnaśriyā'tivikhyātatvaṃ ketakyāmadoṣaḥ | yāvatā guṇa eva, kusumasamṛddhimattāyā bhajanānuguṇatvāt | tadaṃśe kṣudradevatātādātmyamapekṣyaṃ, kṣudradevatāyāṃ ca ketakītādātmyaṃ, tāpasāśritatvasya tattyāgānanuguṇatvāt |

original: prathamamanidrā svapade sā drākṣā kṣāntimattvamupayātā | prāptā'tha kṛṣṇarūpaṃ phale rasaghanā ca kiyadidaṃ bhāgyam || 998 ||
analyzed: prathamam anidrā sva pade sā drākṣā kṣāntimat tvam upayātā prāptā atha kṛṣṇa rūpam phale rasa ghanā ca kiyat idam bhāgyam

original: sā prasiddhā drākṣā mṛdvīkā prathamaṃ ādau svapade svavācakaśabde anidrā nirgato drā iti varṇo yasyāssā na bhavatītyanidrā ‘nivātapadmastimitena' ityādāviva niśabdena samāsaḥ | ādau drāvarṇasahitetyarthaḥ | arthagatasya strītvasya śabde āropaḥ | kṣā ityākārakavarṇaḥ antimo yasya taditi sāmānye napuṃsakam |
analyzed: sā prasiddhā drākṣā mṛdvīkā prathamam ādau sva pade sva vācaka śabde anidrā nirgataḥ drā iti varṇaḥ yasyāḥ sā na bhavati iti anidrā nivāta padma stimitena ityādau iva niśabdena samāsaḥ ādau drā varṇa sahitā iti arthaḥ artha gatasya strītvasya śabde āropaḥ iti ākāraka varṇaḥ antimaḥ yasya tat iti sāmānye napuṃsakam

original: tasya bhāvaḥ kṣāntimattvaṃ 'anaci ca' iti takārasya dvitvam | upayātā kṣākārānvitapaścārdhetyarthaḥ | phale atha kārtsnyena kṛṣṇarūpaṃ asitavarṇatāṃ prāptā phalapariṇāmadaśāyāṃ tathāvidhatvāttasyāḥ | rasaghanā rasasāndrā ca bhavati | pakṣe svapade svatrāṇe svavyavasaye ca ‘padaṃ vyavasitatrāṇasthānalakṣmāṅghrivastuṣu' ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: tasya bhāvaḥ kṣāntimat tvam an a ci ca iti takārasya dvi tvam upayātā kṣākāra anvita paśca ardha iti arthaḥ phale atha kārtsnyena kṛṣṇa rūpam asita varṇa tām prāptā phala pariṇāma daśāyām tathāvidha tvāt tasyāḥ rasa ghanā rasa sāndrā ca bhavati pakṣe sva pade sva trāṇe sva vyavasaye ca padam vyavasita trāṇa sthāna lakṣma aṅghri vastuṣu iti amaraḥ

original: svojjīvane tadarthamupāyānuṣṭhāne ceti bhāvaḥ | anidrā apramattā ata eva kṣāntimato bhāvaḥ kṣāntimattvaṃ ‘śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ' ityuktarītyā titikṣutvam | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ samāhitatvādeḥ | anenopāyānuṣṭhānapūrtiruktā | atha phale phaladaśāyāṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ bhagavatsārūpyaṃ prāptā upāyānuṣṭhānānurūpaṃ phalaṃ prāptavatītyarthaḥ |

original: na ca kārtavīryabhujacchettṛparaśudharajetṛtvarūpavyaṅgyamādāyaiva gaditumarhaṃ paryāyoktaṃ na tu viśeṣaṇasāmarthyalabhyadāśarathitvamādāyeti vācyaṃ, uktavidhaparaśudharajetṛtvarūpavyaṅgyasya vācyasiddhyaṅgatvena tenāpi vivakṣitaṃ vyaṅgyaṃ pradhānabhūtaṃ dāśarathitvamiti tadādāyaiva tadvarṇanasya yuktatvāt |

original: ata eva ‘namastasmai kṛtau yena mudhā rāhuvadhūkucau' ityatra 'atra bhagavān vāsudevassvāsādhāraṇarūpeṇa gamyo rāhuvadhūkucavaiyarthyakāritvena rūpāntareṇābhihitaḥ' iti kuvalayānandoktaṃ saṃgacchate | yattu tatra bhagavadrūpeṇāvagamanaṃ viśeṣaṇamaryādālabhyatvenāsundaraṃ paryāyoktasya viṣaya iti, tadavicāritaramaṇīyam |

original: na hi paryāyokte vyaṅgyasaundaryakṛto vicchittiviśeṣaḥ | yenāsundaratā syāt | kiṃtu bhaṅgyantarābhidhānakṛta eva | vyaṅgyaṃ tu bhaṅgyantarābhidhānato'sundarameva prāyeṇa dṛśyate | yathā ihāgantavyamiti vivakṣite vyaṅgye ayaṃ deśo'laṃkaraṇīyaḥ sāphalyaṃ neya ityādau | tasmāttadasundaratvodbhāvanamakiṃcitkaramevetyalaṃ bahunā |

original: tataścābhīṣṭārthamuddiśya kiṃcitkāryamārabdhavata iṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭāvāptī milite eko bhedaḥ, kevaleṣṭānavāptiḥ kevalāniṣṭāvāptiśceti pratyekaṃ bhedadvayamiti trayo bhedāssaṃgṛhītā bhavanti | iṣṭārthaśca svasya kiṃcitsukhasādhanārthāvāptiḥ duḥkhasādhanānarthanivṛttiśca, parasya duḥkhasādhanānarthaprāpaṇaṃ sukhasādhanārthanivṛttiśceti caturvidhaḥ |

original: tena iṣṭānavāptighaṭite bhedadvitaye'pi cāturvidhyam | aniṣṭaśca svasya duḥkhasādhanānarthaprāptiḥ, parasya sukhasādhanārthaprāptiḥ, duḥkhasādhanānarthanāśaśceti trividhaḥ| svasyeṣṭāprāptistu gaṇiteti nāniṣṭe gaṇyate | tenāniṣṭāvāptighaṭite bhedadvitaye'pi traividhyam ||
analyzed: tena iṣṭa anavāpti ghaṭite bheda dvitaye api cāturvidhyam aniṣṭaḥ ca svasya duḥkha sādhana anartha prāptiḥ parasya sukha sādhana artha prāptiḥ duḥkha sādhana anartha nāśaḥ ca iti trividhaḥ svasya iṣṭa aprāptiḥ tu gaṇitā iti na aniṣṭe gaṇyate tena aniṣṭa avāpti ghaṭite bheda dvitaye api traividhyam

original: udāharaṇāni tatra svasukhasādhanārthāvāptirūpeṣṭārthodyogādiṣṭānavāptau duḥkhasādhanarūpāniṣṭapratilambhe ca yathā rāmaṃ salakṣmaṇaṃ prākprāptā rakṣassvasā vṛṣasyantī | tanmadhye vyagrā'bhūdvigrā navyaṃ mukhe vikāramitā || 1191 ||

original: rakṣassvasā śūrpaṇakhā vṛṣasyaṃtī kāmukī satī ‘aśvakṣīravṛṣalavaṇānāmātmaprītau kyaci' aśvavṛṣayormaithunecchāyām' iti vṛṣaśabdātkyacyasuk | ‘vṛṣasyantī tu kāmukī' ityamaraḥ | salakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaṃ prāptā | tayoḥ rāmalakṣmaṇayormadhye vyagrā tatparihāsavacanairākulā |

original: tatassāhasapravṛttyā vigrā vigatā nāsikā yasyāsseti bahuvrīhau 'vergro vaktavyaḥ' iti viśabdottarasya nāsikāśabdasya grādeśaḥ | ‘vigro vigatanāsikaḥ' ityamaraḥ | lakṣmaṇena cchinnanāsiketi bhāvaḥ | ata eva mukhe vadane navyaṃ apūrvaṃ vikāraṃ vikṛtiṃ itā prāptā abhūt | iṇaḥ kartari ktaḥ |
analyzed: tatas sāhasa pravṛttyā vigrā vigatā nāsikā yasyāḥ sā iti bahuvrīhau vaktavyaḥ iti viśabda uttarasya nāsikā śabdasya vigraḥ vigata nāsikaḥ iti amaraḥ lakṣmaṇena chinna nāsikā iti bhāvaḥ atas eva mukhe vadane navyam apūrvam vikāram vikṛtim itā prāptā abhūt iṇaḥ kartari ktaḥ

original: atra vyagretiśabdaḥ mukhe ādau navyaṃ navidyamāno vya iti varṇasamudayo yasmin karmaṇi tadyathāsyāttathā | naśabdena samāsaḥ | vikāraṃ tatraiva vi ityākārakaṃ varṇaṃ itā satī vigrā'bhūditi yojanā | vigreti niṣpannetyarthaścamatkārī |
analyzed: atra vyagrā iti śabdaḥ mukhe ādau navyam na vidyamānaḥ iti varṇa samudayaḥ yasmin karmaṇi tat yathā syāt tathā na śabdena samāsaḥ vikāram tatra eva vi iti ākārakam varṇam itā satī vigrā abhūt iti yojanā vigrā iti niṣpannā iti arthaḥ camatkārī

original: sarvagandhaṃ 'sarvakarmā sarvakāmassarvagandhaḥ' iti śrutaṃ 'aśabdamasparśam' ityādinā prākṛtagandhādiniṣedhāt aprākṛtāssvāsādhāraṇāḥ nityaniravadyāḥ niratiśayāssvabhogyabhūtāḥ kalyāṇāssarve guṇā asya santītyarthaḥ | īdṛśaṃ tvāṃ candanaḥ prākṛtaparimitagandhāśraya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sarva gandham sarva karmā sarva kāmaḥ sarva gandhaḥ iti śrutam aśabdam asparśam ityādinā prākṛta gandha ādi niṣedhāt aprākṛtāḥ sva asādhāraṇāḥ nitya niravadyāḥ niratiśayāḥ sva bhogya bhūtāḥ kalyāṇāḥ sarve guṇāḥ asya santi iti arthaḥ īdṛśam tvām candanaḥ prākṛta parimita gandha āśrayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: saurabhataḥ jigīṣuryadi cakreṇa sudarśanena bhidāṃ bhedanaṃ ‘sādhanaṃ kṛtā' iti samāsaḥ | cakārasya kretivarṇena bhidāṃ nirasanaṃ ca gantaiva | atha īdṛgavasthāvāptyanantaraṃ krandana eva roditaiva, pakṣe krandanaśabda eva bhavatīti manye | atra candanasyeṣṭālābhāniṣṭalābhau saṃbhāvanayā nibaddhau ||
analyzed: saurabhataḥ jigīṣuḥ yadi cakreṇa sudarśanena bhidām bhedanam sādhanam kṛtāḥ iti samāsaḥ cakārasya bhidām nirasanam ca gantā eva atha īdṛś avasthā avāpti anantaram krandanaḥ eva roditā eva pakṣe krandana śabdaḥ eva bhavati iti manye atra candanasya iṣṭa alābha aniṣṭa lābhau saṃbhāvanayā nibaddhau

original: tādṛśaṃ avarṇaṃ akāro yasya tat nyuditāvarṇaṃ ‘ditaṃ chitaṃ vṛkṇam' ityamaraḥ | nyubjaṃ rujābhagnaṃ abhūt | ‘bhujanyubjau pāṇyupatāpayoḥ' iti nipātanātsādhuḥ | ‘nyubjo rujābhugne' ityamaraḥ | abjapadaṃ nyubjamiti niṣpannamiti vastusthitiḥ | hā iti khede | śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭam ||

original: tanmahasā cakratejasā | niraṃśukaḥ apahṛtavasanaḥ nirgalitakiraṇa iti ca | pakṣe aṃśuśabdavighaṭitaśca kalitaḥ mālī tannāmā mahādaityaḥ bhavan, aṃśumāliśabdaḥ aṃśuśabdavighaṭitatayā mālītyavaśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat ||

original: mālūrasya bilvasya phalaṃ śrīkucajayarūpaṃ phalaṃ prayojanaṃ abhilaṣya apekṣya araṃ drutaṃ tadanulūnaṃ tābhyāṃ kucābhyāṃ anulūnaṃ anantarameva cchinnaṃ na tu vilambena, parājitamiti yāvat | māphalamiti mā bhūtsvoddiṣṭaprayojanaṃ 'jīvanbhadrāṇipaśyati' ityuktanayena kathamapi jīveyamiti svābhilaṣitasādhanānīśvaratayā nairāśyaṃ dadhānamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: mālūrasya bilvasya phalam śrī kuca jaya rūpam phalam prayojanam abhilaṣya apekṣya aram drutam tat anulūnam tābhyām kucābhyām anulūnam anantaram eva chinnam na tu vilambena parājitam iti yāvat mā aphalam iti mā bhūt sva uddiṣṭa prayojanam jīvan bhadrāṇi paśyati iti ukta nayena katham api jīveyam iti sva abhilaṣita sādhana anīśvara tayā nairāśyam dadhānam iti bhāvaḥ

original: abhidhāvat pratipakṣabhiyā abhitaḥ palāyamānam | aṃbhipūrvakāddhāvaterlaṭaśśatā | tathā lipitaḥ tādṛśakarmaphalasūcakavaidhasalalāṭarekhāvaśāt anuśiṣṭaṃ prāṇamātrāvaśeṣaṃ sat vācyaṃ nirvīryāmidamiti kutsanīyaṃ 'vācyaṃ tu kutsite hīne vacanīye ca vācyavat' iti medinī, abhūt |
analyzed: abhidhāvat pratipakṣa bhiyā abhitas palāyamānam tathā lipitaḥ tādṛśa karma phala sūcaka vaidhasa lalāṭa rekhā vaśāt anuśiṣṭam prāṇa mātra avaśeṣam sat vācyam nirvīryām idam iti kutsanīyam vācyam tu kutsite hīne vacanīye ca vācya vat iti medinī abhūt

original: pakṣe mālūraphalamitipadaṃ, śabdārthayostādātmyam, tadanu lakṣmīkucajayaphalābhilāṣānantaraṃ lūnaṃ lūvarṇena nyūnaṃ araṃ avidyamānarephaṃ ca sat lipitaḥ svaghaṭakākṣaraiḥ māphalamiti suśiṣṭaṃ samyagavaśiṣṭaṃ abhidhāvat abhidhā sākṣātsaṃketaviṣayajñānahetubhūtaśśabdaniṣṭho mukhyo vyāpāraḥ 'vyāpāraśśakyadhīheturmukhyaśśabdagatoSbhidhā' iti lakṣaṇāt,
analyzed: pakṣe mālūra phalam iti padam śabda arthayoḥ tādātmyam tadanu lakṣmī kuca jaya phala abhilāṣa anantaram lūnam lū varṇena nyūnam aram a vidyamāna repham ca sat lipitaḥ sva ghaṭaka akṣaraiḥ mā phalam iti su śiṣṭam samyak avaśiṣṭam abhidhāvat abhidhā sākṣāt saṃketa viṣaya jñāna hetu bhūtaḥ śabda niṣṭhaḥ mukhyaḥ vyāpāraḥ vyāpāraḥ śakya dhī hetuḥ mukhyaḥ śabda gataḥ abhidhā iti lakṣaṇāt

original: sā'syāstīti tathoktaṃ sat, matup | vācyaṃ vaktavyaṃ abhūt | śrīphalarūpārthaviṣayakaśaktimattayā vyavahāryamāsīditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sā asya asti iti tathā uktam sat matup vācyam vaktavyam abhūt śrīphala rūpa artha viṣayaka śaktimat tayā vyavahāryam āsīt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadvā mālūraphalarūpārtha eva lipitaḥ svavācakaśabdasthavarṇaiḥ tathā uktarītyā lūravarṇatyāgena suśiṣṭaṃ samyagavaśiṣṭaṃ sat, māphalamiti abhidhā nāmadheyaṃ sā'syāstītyabhidhāvat, svavācakamāphalarūpaśabdavatsat vācyaṃ vaktuṃ yogyaṃ abhūt, svābhidheyārthamajahadeva vyavahārārhamāsīdityarthaḥ | māphalaṃ śrīphalam |
analyzed: yat vā mālūra phala rūpa arthaḥ eva lipitaḥ sva vācaka śabda stha varṇaiḥ tathā ukta rītyā lūra varṇa tyāgena su śiṣṭam samyak avaśiṣṭam sat māphalam iti abhidhā nāmadheyam sā asya asti iti abhidhāvat sva vācaka māphala rūpa śabdavat sat vācyam vaktum yogyam abhūt sva abhidheya artham ajahat eva vyavahāra arham āsīt iti arthaḥ māphalam śrīphalam

original: bilvasya māphalavaṃ ca ‘vanaspatistava vṛkṣo'tha bilvaḥ' iti śruteḥ | ‘bilvo lakṣmyāḥ kare'bhavat' iti vidyāraṇyabhāṣyadhṛtavāmanapurāṇāt ‘tanumadhyā svahastotthaṃ bilvaṃ tarumupāśritā' iti pṛthvīdharabhāṣyadhṛtabhārgavatantravacanācceti dhyeyam | phalati niṣpadyata iti phalaḥ pacādyac |
analyzed: bilvasya ca vanaspatiḥ tava vṛkṣaḥ atha bilvaḥ iti śruteḥ bilvaḥ lakṣmyāḥ iti vidyāraṇya bhāṣya dhṛta vāmanapurāṇāt tanu madhyā sva hasta uttham bilvam tarum upāśritā iti pṛthvīdhara bhāṣya dhṛta bhārgavatantra vacanāt ca iti dhyeyam phalati niṣpadyate iti phalaḥ

original: māyāḥ phalaḥ māphalaḥ lakṣmīkaraniṣpannatvānmāphalaśabdo bilvavācī | tasya vikāraḥ phalaṃ māphalam | yadvā māpradāni śrīpradāni phalāni yasya sa iti māphalaḥ śākapārthiva itivanmadhyamapadalopi samāsaḥ | ‘tasya phalāni tapasā nudantu māyāntarāyāśca bāhyā alakṣmīḥ' ityalakṣmyapanodakatvaśravaṇācchrīpradaphala ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: māyāḥ phalaḥ māphalaḥ lakṣmī kara niṣpanna tvāt māphala śabdaḥ bilva vācī tasya vikāraḥ phalam māphalam yat vā mā pradāni śrī pradāni phalāni yasya saḥ iti māphalaḥ śāka pārthivaḥ itivat madhyamapada lopi samāsaḥ tasya phalāni tapasā nudantu māyā antarāyāḥ ca bāhyā alakṣmīḥ iti alakṣmī apanodaka tva śravaṇāt śrī prada phalaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tataḥ phalārthe vaikārikāṇo luk | māphalaśabdasya ‘bilve śāṇḍilyaśailṛṣau mālūraśrīphalavapi, iti kośaghaṭakaśrīphalaśabdavadbilvābhidhāyitvaṃ lakṣmīpatyādiśabdānāṃ ‘śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ' ityādikośaghaṭakaśrīpatyādiśabdānāṃ puruṣottamābhidhāyakatvamiveti dhyeyam | atra mālūraphalasya parānarthaprāpaṇarūpeṣṭānavāptyaniṣṭaprāptī nibaddhe ||
analyzed: tatas phala arthe luk māphala śabdasya bilve śāṇḍilya śailṛṣau mālūra śrīphala vapi iti kośa ghaṭaka śrīphala śabda vat bilva abhidhāyi tvam lakṣmīpati ādi śabdānām śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ iti ādi kośa ghaṭaka śrīpati ādi śabdānām puruṣottama abhidhāyaka tvam iva iti dhyeyam atra mālūra phalasya para anartha prāpaṇa rūpa iṣṭa anavāpti aniṣṭa prāptī nibaddhe

original: yathāvā

original: mālūraṃ harimahile saṃnaddhaṃ tava kucābhibhavane tābhyām | ekādimābhighātācchātaṃ śritanīrakaṃ ca śālūkamabhūt || 1238 ||

original: he harimahile! mālūrasya vikāraḥ phalaṃ mālūram | vaikārikāṇo luk, klībamiti bhāvaḥ | tava kucayoḥ abhibhavane nyūnīkaraṇe sannaddhaṃ ata eva tābhyāṃ tava kucābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pumbhyāmiti bhāvaḥ | ekasmāt ādimāt ādyāt abhighātāt prahārādeva chātaṃ chinnaṃ ‘cho chedane' asmātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | 'ādecaḥ' ityātvam | ‘chinnaṃ chātam' ityamaraḥ|
analyzed: he hari mahile mālūrasya vikāraḥ phalam mālūram luk klībam iti bhāvaḥ tava kucayoḥ abhibhavane nyūnīkaraṇe sannaddham atas eva tābhyām tava kucābhyām dvābhyām pumbhyām iti bhāvaḥ ekasmāt ādimāt ādyāt abhighātāt prahārāt eva chātam chinnam chedane asmāt karmaṇi ktaḥ iti ātvam chinnam chātam iti amaraḥ

original: śātamiti vā cchedaḥ | śātaṃ tanūkṛtaṃ karśitamityarthaḥ | ‘śo tanūkaraṇe' asmāt ktaḥ, ātvaṃ ca prāgvat | ata eva śritanīrakaṃ śritaṃ nīraṃ yena tattathoktaṃ ca sat | bahuvrīhau śeṣādvibhāṣā' iti kap | punaḥ prahārabhiyā jale nimagnamita bhāvaḥ | śalūkaṃ ‘saugandhikaṃ tu kahlāram' ityupakramya ‘śālūkameṣāṃ kandassyāt' ityamaraḥ |
analyzed: śātam iti vā chedaḥ śātam tanūkṛtam karśitam iti arthaḥ tanūkaraṇe asmāt ktaḥ ātvam ca prāgvat atas eva śrita nīrakam śritam nīram yena tat tathā uktam ca sat bahuvrīhau śeṣāt vibhāṣā iti kap punar prahāra bhiyā jale nimagnam ita bhāvaḥ śalūkam saugandhikam tu kahlāram iti upakramya śālūkam eṣām kandaḥ syāt iti amaraḥ

original: śalyate śalati vā ‘śala calanasaṃvaraṇayoḥ' ‘śalimaṇḍibhyāmūkaṇ' iti ūkaṇpratyayaḥ | idaṃ ca sudhāyāṃ spaṣṭam | pakṣe mālūramiti padaṃ ekasya ādeḥ prāthamikasya mākārasya abhighātāt dhvaṃsanaṃ prāpya śātaṃ śāṃ śākāraṃ atati satataṃ gacchatīti tathoktaṃ ‘ata sātatyagamane' karmaṇyaṇ |
analyzed: śalyate śalati vā śala calana saṃvaraṇayoḥ śali maṇḍibhyām ūkaṇ iti ūkaṇ pratyayaḥ idam ca sudhāyām spaṣṭam pakṣe mālūram iti padam ekasya ādeḥ prāthamikasya mākārasya abhighātāt dhvaṃsanam prāpya śātam śām śākāram atati satatam gacchati iti tathā uktam ataḥ sātatya gamane karmaṇi aṇ

original: śritanīrakaṃ nirgamito raḥ rephaḥ yena saḥ nīraḥ, nīraḥ kaḥ kakāraḥ śrito yena tattathoktaṃ ca lat , mākārasthāne śākāraṃ rephasthāne kakāraṃ ca prāptaṃ śālūkamiti niṣpannamityarthaḥ | atra mālūrasya śrīkucābhibhavanarūpeṣṭānavāptiḥ abhighātādinā śālūkatvarūpāniṣṭāvāptiśca ||
analyzed: śrita nīrakam nirgamitaḥ raḥ rephaḥ yena saḥ nīraḥ nīraḥ kaḥ kakāraḥ śritaḥ yena tat tathā uktam ca lat mākāra sthāne śākāram repha sthāne kakāram ca prāptam śālūkam iti niṣpannam iti arthaḥ atra mālūrasya śrī kuca abhibhavana rūpa iṣṭa anavāptiḥ abhighāta ādinā śālūka tva rūpa aniṣṭa avāptiḥ ca

original: gatigarvādabhiyaṃstvāṃ mukhavātyādhūta uparigata evāgre | vāraṇa uraṇassamajani na puraskurute raṇaṃ tadadyāpyeṣaḥ || 1239 ||
analyzed: gati garvāt abhiyan tvām mukhavātī ādhūtaḥ upari gataḥ eva agre vāraṇaḥ uraṇaḥ samajani na puraskurute raṇam tat adya api eṣaḥ

original: he bhagavan! vāraṇaḥ gatigarvāt gamanagambhīryaprayuktādahaṃkārāt abhiyan abhiyogārthamabhimukhaṃ gacchan san mukhavātyādhūtaḥ | asya tavetyādiḥ | tava mukhavātyayā mukhaniśvāsaphūtkārabhūmnaiva dhūtaḥ | vātānāṃ samūho vātyā 'pāśādibhyo yaḥ' iti sāmūhiko yapratyayaḥ | 'tal bṛnde yenikaḍyactrāḥ' ityanuśāsanāt strītvam |
analyzed: he bhagavan vāraṇaḥ gati garvāt gamana gambhīrya prayuktāt ahaṃkārāt abhiyan abhiyoga artham abhimukham gacchan san mukhavātyā dhūtaḥ asya tava ityādiḥ tava mukhavātyayā mukha niśvāsa phūtkāra bhūmnā eva dhūtaḥ vātānām samūhaḥ vātyā pāśa ādibhyaḥ yaḥ iti sāmūhikaḥ ya pratyayaḥ tat bṛnde iti anuśāsanāt strītvam

original: anena strīparājitatvaṃ dyotyate | ata eva agre anantaraṃ uparigata eva kvāpi gagane uṭṭaṅkitassannityarthaḥ| uraṇaḥ meṣaḥ ajani | meṣajanmābhajadityarthaḥ | tadvannirvīryo'bhavaditi vā | gagane meṣarāśitāṃ gata ityapi gamyate | ata eva eṣaḥ vāraṇaḥ uraṇo vā adyāpi raṇaṃ yuddhaṃ na puraskurute nādriyate parābhavabhayāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: anena strī parājita tvam dyotyate atas eva agre anantaram upari gataḥ eva kvāpi gagane uṭṭaṅkitaḥ san iti arthaḥ uraṇaḥ meṣaḥ ajani meṣa janma abhajat iti arthaḥ tadvat nirvīryaḥ bhavat iti vā gagane meṣa rāśi tām gataḥ iti api gamyate atas eva eṣaḥ vāraṇaḥ uraṇaḥ vā adya api raṇam yuddham na puraskurute na ādriyate parābhava bhayāt iti bhāvaḥ
